to swear a person, administer an oath to one, c. acc. pers., or absol., ἐξορκούντων οἱ πρυτάνεις Foed. ap. Thuc., Dem.; followed by ἦ μήν (ionic ἦ μέν) c. inf. fut., Hdt., etc.: c. acc. rei, to make one swear by a thing, Id.
a binding by oath, Hdt.
to send forth, send to war, Aesch., Eur.; ἐξ. τὴν ναῦν to start the ship, set it agoing, Thuc.:—Pass. to set out, start, Hdt., Eur., etc.; of arrows, to spring from the bow, Id.
to excite to action, urge on, Id., Thuc.
intr., like Pass., to set out, start, of a ship, Od., Xen.: c. gen. to set out from, Eur.:—metaph. to break out, of a disease, Soph.; σφοδρὸς ἐφ’ ὅ τι ἐφορμήσειε eager in all that he attempted, Plat.
to be out of harbour, run out, Aeschin.
to bring out of harbour, Dem.
to let down, Eur.: perf. pass. in mid. sense, ἐξώρμισαι σὸν πόδα thou hast come forth, Id.
sailing from a harbour, c. gen., Eur.
to leap forth, Hom.
to dig out the earth from a trench, Hdt.
to dig out of the ground, dig up, Id., Ar.: metaph., ἐξ. αὐτῶν τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς Hdt.
Dep.
to dance away, hop off, Dem.
c. acc. rei, to dance out, i. e. to let out, betray secrets, Luc.
to dedicate, devote, Plut.
to banish by ostracism, Hdt., Plat.
banishment by ostracism, Plut.
from the time when, Ar.
to stir up, urge on, excite, τινὰ ποιεῖν τι Aesch., Eur.; τινὰ ἐπί τι Thuc.
to set at naught, NTest.
ἐξούλης δίκη, an action against exclusion, brought by one who was excluded from property by the defendant in a suit, Dem.
power or authority to do a thing, c. inf., Thuc., Xen.; c. gen. power over, licence in a thing, Thuc., Plat.
absol. power, authority, might, as opp. to right, Thuc.: also licence, Dem.
an office, magistracy, Lat. potestas, Plat.
as concrete, also like Lat. potestas, the body of the magistrates, in pl., the authorities, NTest.
abundance of means, resources, Thuc.
pomp, Plut.
to exercise over, c. gen., NTest.
to increase exceedingly, ἐξώφελλεν ἔεδνα offered still higher dowry, Od.
with prominent eyes, Xen.
prominence: οἱ κατ’ ἐξοχήν the chiefmen, NTest.
standing out: metaph. eminent, excellent, Hom.

c. gen. standing out from, most eminent, greatest, mightiest, used like a superl., ἔξοχος ἡρώων, ἔξ. ἄλλων Il.; but a real Sup. ἐξοχώτατος Aesch., Eur.:—also c. dat., μέγ’ ἔξοχοι αἰπολίοισιν eminent among the herds, Od.; so, ἐν πολλοῖσι ἔξοχος ἡρώεσσιν Il.
neut. pl. ἔξοχα as adv., especially, above others, Hom.; ἐμοὶ δόσαν ἔξοχα gave me as a high honour, Od.; ἔξοχ’ ἄριστοι beyond compare the best, Hom.
c. gen., ἔξοχα πάντων far above all, Id.
to fortify strongly, Plut.
to break out into insolence, to run riot, wax wanton, Hdt., Thuc., etc.; ἐξ. ἐς τόδε to come to this pitch of insolence, Id.: with an adj. neut., παντοῖα ἐξ. to commit all kinds of violence, Hdt.
σμῶδιξ μεταφρένου ἐξυπανέστη a weal started up from under the skin of the back, Il.
to advise, Eur.
six, Hom., etc.—In composition, before δ κ π, it becomes ἑκ, as ἕκδραχμος, ἑκκαίδεκα, ἕκπλεθρος; or has α inserted, as ἑξάκλινος, etc.
Lat. ex, the form of the prep. ἐκ, before a vowel and before some consonants, as ῥ σ.
from above, Soph.
to assist to the utmost, Soph.
to awaken from sleep, NTest.: —Pass. to wake up, Plut.
awakened out of sleep, NTest.
to turn upside down, Lat. resupinare, Aesch.; ἐξ. ἑαυτόν throwing back his head haughtily, Luc.
to finish weaving, Hdt.
a finished web, Eur.
to lead the way, Soph.
from without, Trag., Plat., etc.:— c. gen., ἔξ. δόμων from without the house, Eur.
= ἔξω, Hdt., Plat., etc.; οἱ ἔξωθεν foreigners, Hdt.; τὰ ἔξωθεν matters outside the house, Aesch., etc.:—c. gen. without, free from, Soph., Eur.
to thrust out, force out, wrench out, Il.: to expel, eject, banish, Soph.:— to thrust back, Id., Thuc.:—Pass., ἐξωθέεσθαι ἐκ τῆς χώρης Hdt.; πατρίδος ἐξωθούμενος Soph.
ἐξ. γλώσσας ὀδύναν to put forth painful words, to break forth into cruel words, Id.
to drive out of the sea, drive on shore, Lat. ejicere, Thuc.: metaph., ἐξωσθῆναι ἐς χειμῶνα Id.
utter destruction, κατ’ ἐξωλείας ὀμόσαι to swear with deadly imprecations against oneself, Dem.; ἐπαρᾶσθαι ἐξώλειαν αὑτῷ Id.
utterly destroyed, Hdt., Dem.: in imprecations, ἐξ. ἀπόλοιο Ar.; cf. προώλης.
one with arms bare to the shoulder, Luc.
the making of an ἐξωμίς, Xen.
a man's vest without sleeves, leaving both shoulders bare, or with one sleeve, leaving one shoulder bare, Ar., Xen.
denial on oath that one knows anything of a matter, Ar., Dem.
a declining an office on oath, in case of ill health, Id.
Dep. to buy off, redeem:—generally, to buy, Hdt., Aeschin.
out of sight of, c. gen., Eur.
to leave out of thought, Aesch.

entry.etym: adverb of ἐξ, as εἴσω of εἰς
entry.sense: of Place
with Verbs of motion, out, ἔξω ἰών Od.; χωρεῖν ἔξω Hdt., etc.:—c. gen. out of, Hom., etc.:—c. acc., ἔξω τὸν Ἑλλήσποντον outside the H., Hdt.

without any sense of motion, like ἐκτός, outside, without, Od.: τὸ ἔξω the outside, Thuc.; τὰ ἔξω things outside the walls, Id.; τὰ ἔξω πράγματα foreign affairs, Id.;— οἱ ἔξω those outside, Id. (in NTest. the heathen); —ἡ ἔξω θάλασσα, the Ocean, opp. to ἡ ἐντός (the Mediterranean sea), Hdt.:—c. gen., οἱ ἔξω γένους Soph.; ἔξω τοξεύματος, ἔξω βελῶν out of shot, Thuc., Xen.; ἔξω τινὸς εἶναι to have nothing to do with it, Thuc.; ἔξω τοῦ φρονεῖν out of one's senses, Eur.:—proverb., ἔξω τοῦ πηλοῦ αἴρειν πόδα to keep clear of difficulties, Aesch.; πημάτων ἔξω πόδα ἔχειν Id.
of Time, beyond, over, ἔξω μέσου ἡμέρας Xen.
without, but, except, c. gen., , Hdt., Thuc.
untimely, out of season, unfitting, Soph.:— superannuated, Aeschin.
one who drives out, Eur.:— ἐξ. ἄνεμοι violent winds which drive ships ashore, Hdt.
outermost, Plat.
outer, utter, NTest.
more outside, c. gen., Aesch.

entry.etym: from εἴκω, of which we have 3rd sg. imperf. εἶκε, it seemed good, Il.; fut. εἴξω, will be like, Ar.
entry.sense: to be like:

to be like, look like, τινι Hom., etc.:—with the part., where we use the inf., αἰεὶ γὰρ δίφρου ἐπιβησομένοισι ἐΐκτην seemed always just about to set foot upon the chariot, Il.; ἔοικε σπεύδοντι seems anxious, Plat.

to seem likely, c. inf., in phrases which we render by making the Verb impersonal, as in the Lat. videor videre, methinks I see, χλιδᾶν ἔοικας methinks thou art delicate, Aesch.; ἔοικα οὐκ εἰδέναι Soph.
impers., ἔοικε it seems; ὡς ἔοικε as it seems, Id., etc.; ὡς ἔοικε used to modify a statement, probably, I believe, Plat.:—so also personal, ὡς ἔοικας Soph.
to beseem, befit, c. dat. pers., Xen.
impers., ἔοικε it is fitting, right, seemly, reasonable, mostly with a negat. and foll. by inf., οὐκ ἔστ’, οὐδὲ ἔοικε, ἀρνήσασθαι it is not possible, nor is it seemly, to deny, Hom.
part. ἐοικώς, εἰκώς, ionic οἰκώς, υῖα, ός,
seeming like, like, Id., etc.
fitting, seemly, meet, Id.
likely, probable, εἰκός ἐστι, for ἔοικε, Soph.; also ὡς εἰκός, ionic ὡς οἰκός, for ὡς ἔοικε, Hdt., etc.
similarly, like, Aesch.
reasonably, fairly, naturally, Hdt.; οὐκ εἰκότως unfairly, Thuc.
to keep festival or holiday, Hdt., Eur.
to celebrate as or by a festival, Plut.
of or for a festival, Luc.
a feast or festival, holiday, Od., Hdt., etc.; ὁρτὴν or ἑορτὴν ἄγειν to keep a feast, Id., Thuc.; ἑορτὴν ἑορτάζειν Xen.
generally, holidaymaking, amusement, pastime, Aesch., Thuc.
possessive adj. of 3 pers. sg. his, her own, Lat. suus, Hom., etc.; never in attic Prose.
Pass. to glory in, exult in a thing, c. dat., Il.; ἐπί τινι Xen.
to be indignant at, Plut.
a public denunciation of one who, being subject to ἀτιμία, yet takes partin public affairs, Aeschin., Dem.
an offer, promise, profession, Id.
to tell, proclaim, announce, Od., Hdt., etc.:— Mid. to let proclamation be made, Id.
to give orders, command, Id., Thuc.; c. acc., στρατιὰν ἐπ., like Lat. milites imperare, to order an army to be furnished, Thuc.:—also in Mid., Hdt.
as Attic law-term, to denounce one who, having incurred ἀτιμία, yet takes part in public affairs, Aeschin., etc.
to promise, τί τινι Aesch.:—so in Mid., Hdt., attic:—absol. to make offers, Hdt.
to profess, make profession of, τι Dem.:—so in Mid., like Lat. profiteri, Xen., Plat.
to demand, require, Foed. ap. Thuc.; so in Mid., Dem.
a promise, profession, Dem.:— one's profession, Plat.
to gather together, collect, of things, Il.:—Pass., of men, to assemble, Od.
a mustering of forces, Hdt.
to bring to, Hdt.
to honour still more:—Pass. to pride oneself on a thing, glory or exult in it, Il.
to break: perf. ἐπέᾱγα intr., Hes.
to keep awake and brood over, τινί Plut., Luc.
to bring on, Od., Aesch.: to bring upon, τί τινι Hes., attic
to set on, urge on, as hunters do dogs, Od., Xen.
to lead on an army against the enemy, Hdt., Thuc., etc.
to lead on by persuasion, influence, Od., Eur.; c. inf. to induce him to do, Id.
to bring in, invite as aiders or allies, Hdt., Dem.
to bring to a place, bring in, Hdt., etc.:— to bring in, supply, Thuc.
to lay on or apply to one, ἐπ. κέντρον ἵπποις, of a charioteer, Eur.; ἔπαγε γνάθον lay your jaws to it, Ar.
to bring forward, propose a measure, Thuc., Xen.; so, ἐπ. δίκην, γραφήν τινι, Lat. intendere litem alicui, Plat., etc.
to bring in over and above, to add, τι Aesch., Ar.:— to intercalate days in the year, Hdt.
Mid. to procure or provide for oneself, Thuc.:—metaph., Ἅιδα φεῦξιν ἐπ. to devise, invent a means of shunning death, Soph.
of persons, to bring into one's country, bring in or introduce as allies, Hdt., Thuc.
to call in as witnesses, adduce, Plat., etc.
to bring upon oneself, φθόνον Xen.; δουλείαν Dem.
to bring with one, Xen.
to bring over to oneself, win over, Thuc.
a bringing in, supplying, Thuc.
a bringing in to one's aid, introduction, Id.
a drawing on, alluring, Dem.
imported, Plut.
attractive, tempting, alluring, seductive, Hdt., Thuc.:— ἐπαγωγόν ἐστι, c. inf., it is a temptation, Xen.
Dep. to contend with, τινι Plut.
c. dat. rei, to contend for a thing, NTest.
helping in the contest, Aesch.
to sing to or in accompaniment, Hdt., Eur.
to sing as an incantation, Xen., Plat.;—absol., ἐπαείδων by means of charms, Aesch.
to make to grow or prosper, Od.
the prize of a contest, Plut.
Pass. to assemble besides, NTest., Plut.
to cry αἰαῖ over, mourn over, τινί Luc.
to join in wailing, Bion.
on the beach, Anth.
to rush furiously upon, of a stormy wind, Hom.
Dep., to be ashamed, c. inf., Eur.; σὺ δ’ οὐκ ἐπαιδεῖ, εἰ .. , te non pudet, si . . , Soph.
to kindle, set on fire, Anth.
praise, Eur.
one must praise, Plat.
a commender, admirer, Thuc.
to be praised, laudable, Plat.

entry.note: epic imperf. ἐπῄνεον fut. -έσω or -έσομαι poet. ήσω aor1 ἐπῄνεσα aor1 ἐπῄνησα perf. ἐπῄνεκα Pass., fut. -αινεθήσομαι aor1 ἐπῃνέθην
entry.etym: poetic but not Attic are ἐπ-αινήσω, ἐπ-ῄνησα
entry.sense: to approve, applaud, commend, Lat. laudare, Hom., etc.; ἐπ. τινά τι to commend one for a thing, Aesch.
to compliment publicly, panegyrize, Thuc.
to undertake to do, c. inf., Eur.
the aor. ἐπῄνεσα is in attic used in a pres. sense, ἐπῄνες’ ἔργον I commend it, Soph.: and absol., well done! Ar.
to recommend, exhort, advise, c. inf., Soph.
as a civil form of declining an offer, I thank you, I am much obliged, κάλλιστ’, ἐπαινῶ Ar.; so, ἐπ. τὴν κλῆσιν to decline it, Xen.
of Rhapsodists, to declaim, Plat.
approval, praise, commendation, Hdt., attic
dread, Hom.

entry.note: ionic and poet. ἐπαείρω fut. -ᾰρῶ aor1 -ῆρα Pass., aor1 ἐπήρθην
entry.sense: to lift up and set on a car or stand, c. gen., Il.
to lift, raise, Id., Soph., etc.: Mid., ὅπλα ἐπαίρεσθαι Eur.
to exalt, magnify, Xen.
intr. to lift up one's leg or rise up, Hdt.
to stir up, excite, Id., Soph., etc.: — to induce or persuade one to do, c. inf., Hdt., Ar.: —Pass. to be led on, excited, Hdt., etc.
Pass., also, to be elated at a thing, Id., Thuc., etc.:—absol. to be conceited or proud, Ar.
Dep.
to have a perception or feeling of, c. gen., Soph.
c. acc. to perceive, hear, Aesch., Soph.

entry.note: fut. ΐξω contr. attic -ᾴσσω or -ττω fut. -ᾴξω
entry.sense: to rush at or upon, c. gen., Il.
c. dat. pers. to rush upon her, Od.
c. acc. to assail, assault, Ἕκτορα Il.:—Mid., ἐπαΐξασθαι ἄεθλον to rush at (i. e. seize upon) the prize, Id.
absol., of a hawk, ταρφέ’ ἐπαΐσσει makes frequent swoops, Id.; of the wind, Id., attic
later, ἐπ. πόδα to move with hasty step, Eur.:—Pass., χεῖρες ἐπαΐσσονται they move lightly, Il.
heard of, detected, Hdt.
Dep.:— to be ashamed at or of, τινι Hdt.; τινι Hdt.; τινα or τι Xen.:—c. inf. to be ashamed to do, Aesch.; c. part. to be ashamed of doing or having done a thing, Hdt., Soph., etc.
to ask besides, Il., Soph.:—so in Mid., Id.

Dep.:— to bring a charge against, accuse, τινα Hdt., attic; ἐπ. τινά τινος to accuse one of a thing, Thuc., Dem.; c. inf. to accuse one of doing a thing, Soph., etc.:—c. acc. rei, to lay the blame upon, Thuc., Plat.
blamed for a thing, blameable, blameworthy, Il., Aesch., etc.
to give ear to, c. gen., Aesch., Eur.
to perceive, feel, c. gen., Hdt.
to understand, c. acc., Soph., Ar.
to profess knowledge, to be a professor in any subject, Plat.
to keep hovering over, keep in suspense, Anth.
Pass. to hover over, to buoy up, Luc.
to overhang, threaten, τινί Plut.
to come to its bloom, Luc.
to follow close upon, follow after, τινί Ar., Plat.;—absol., Thuc., etc.
to pursue as an enemy, Id., etc.
to follow mentally, τῷ λόγῳ Plat.
to follow, i. e. comply with, τοῖς πάθεσι Dem.
a consequence, Plut.
attentive to, c. gen., Hes.
to listen or hearken to, to hear, c. acc., Hom., attic: also c. gen., Hdt., Eur.:— c. acc. rei et gen. pers. to hear a thing from a person, Od.
absol. to give ear, hearken, Aesch., etc.
to obey, τινός Il., Soph.
to reach the top of a thing, αἱμάτων ἐπήκρισε he reached the highest point in deeds of blood, Aesch.
one must apply, Luc.
a hunter, Hom.
on the shore, Soph., Eur.
brought in, imported, Hdt., Thuc., etc.
of persons, alien, Eur.;—of foreign allies or mercenaries, Aesch., Soph.;—also, ἐπακτὸς ἀνήρ, i. e. an adulterer, Id.; ἐπ. πατήρ a false father, Eur.
brought upon oneself, Soph., Eur.
a light vessel, skiff, Xen.
a light piratical skiff, Aeschin.
to raise the war-cry, Aesch., Xen.
Dep. with aor1 pass. to wander about or over, πόλλ’ ἐπαληθείς Od.
to be full of wrath at a thing, Od.
to grieve over, c. gen., Eur.
to smear over, plaster up, Od.
to defend, aid, help, τινί Il.
to ward off, keep off, c. acc., Id.
to prove true, verify, Thuc.
open to the sun, sunny, Hes.
strong, Aesch.
an interchange, Hdt.

entry.note: attic -ττω fut. άξω perf. -ήλλᾰχα Pass. -ήλλαχμαι aor1 pass. -ηλλάχθην aor2 pass -ηλλάγην
entry.sense: to interchange, πολέμοιο πεῖραρ ἐπαλλάξαντες making the rope-end of war go now this way, now that, i. e. fighting with doubtful victory, (metaph. from a game like "soldiers and sailors"), Il.:—Pass. to cross one another, Xen.; ποὺς ἐπαλλαχθεὶς ποδί closely joined, Eur.: to be entangled, perplexed, Xen.
one after another, ἐπαλλήλοιν χεροῖν by one another's hands, Soph.
a means of defence: in pl. battlements, Il., Hdt., etc.:—in sg. the battlements, parapet, Il., Thuc.
generally, a defence, protection, Aesch., Eur.
to traverse with cars, γῆ ἐπημαξευμένη τροχοῖσι marked with the tracks of wheels, Soph.
Mid. to scrape together for oneself, εὐνὴν ἐπαμήσατο heaped him up a bed (of leaves), Od.; γῆν ἐπαμησάμενος having heaped up a grave, Hdt.
one who mounts upon, an assailant, Aesch.
to exchange, barter, Il.:—Mid. to come one after another, come in turn to, Id.
interchangeably, Od.
in exchange, Hhymn.
to put on over, Eur.
a helper, defender, Od.
to come to aid, defend, assist, τινί Il., Thuc., etc.:—absol., Il., Hdt., etc.
of words, to admit a double sense, Plat.; of persons, to play a double game, Thuc.
thrown over, Hdt.
to cry out, Ar.
to compel by force, constrain to do a thing, c. inf., Aesch., Ar.
ἐπάναγκες [ἐστί] it is necessary, c. inf., etc.: as adv. by compulsion, Hdt.
to proclaim publicly:—impers. in Pass., ἐπαναγορεύεται proclamation is made, Ar.
to bring up: to stir up, excite, Hdt.
to draw back an army, Thuc.
to bring back to the point, Xen., Dem.
intr. to withdraw, retreat, Xen.
to put out to sea, ναῦς Id.; and without ναῦς, NTest.: so in Pass. to put to sea against, τινι Hdt.; absol., Id., Thuc.
Dep. to contemplate again, Xen.
Mid. to take upon one, enter into, Lat. suscipere, Plat.
to withdraw, Plut.
to lift up, Xen.:—Mid. to raise one against another, Soph., Thuc.:—Pass. to rise up, Ar.
to invoke besides, Aesch.
Pass. to be imposed upon as punishment, τινι Xen.
to give tongue again and again, Xen.
to have an upward tendency, Xen.
to take up again, resume, repeat, Plat.
to revise, correct, Id.
to consume still more, χρόνον Dem.
to wait longer, Hdt.
to wait for one, τινά Ar.:—impers., τί μ’ ἐπαμμένει παθεῖν; what is there in store for me to suffer? Aesch.
to remind one of, τινά τι Plat.
Mid. to renew, revive, Plat.
Mid. to rest upon, depend upon, τινι and ἐπί τινα NTest.
to leap upon, Ar.
to put to sea against, ἐπί τινα Hdt.; ἐπί τι for a purpose, Xen.
to sail back again, Id.
metaph., ἐπαναπλώει ὑμῖν ἔπεα κακά ill language floats upwards, rises, to your tongue, Hdt.
to tear open again, Plut.
to throw up in the air: intr. (sub. ἑαυτόν) to spring high in the air, Xen.
a brandishing against, Thuc.
to consider yet again, Plat.
a rising up against, an insurrection, Hdt., Thuc.; ἐπαναστάσεις θρόνων rebellions (i. e. rebels) against the throne, Soph.
intr. to turn back upon one, wheel round and return to the charge, Ar., Thuc.:— so in Pass., Ar.
to stretch out and hold up, Xen.; ἐπ. ἐλπίδας to hold out hopes, Id.
Mid. to hold over as a threat, Luc.
to lift up, raise, Eur.
intr. to rise, of the sun, Hdt.; to rise from bed, Aesch.:— to appear, Id., Eur.
to lay upon, τί τινι Ar.
to recur, πρός τι Luc.
to throw back upon, ascribe, refer, τι τίνι or εἴς τινα Solon., Ar., etc.
to put into the account, Dem.
to bring back a message, in Mid., Xen.
intr. to come back, return, ἐπί τι Plat.
Pass. to rise, as an exhalation, Xen.
to go back again, to retreat, return, Hdt., attic
a return, Thuc.
to reiterate questions, Aesch.
to go back, return, Thuc.:—in writing or speaking, to return to a point, Hdt., etc.
c. acc. rei, to recapitulate, Plat.
aor2 with no pres. in use, to offer by public proclamation, Thuc.
Mid., to question again and again, Hdt.:—attic aor2 ἐπανηρόμην Aesch., Ar.; τὸν θεὸν ἐπανήροντο εἰ . . Thuc.
to ask again, ἐπ. τινά τι Plat.
Dep. with aor2 and perf. act.:— to go back, return, ἐκ τόπου Thuc.:—in writing or speaking, to return to a point, Eur., Xen., Dem.
c. acc. rei, to recapitulate, Xen.
to go up, ascend, Id.: to go up or pass from one place to another, Hdt.
of persons, to question again, Xen.
of things, to ask over again, Plat.
to hold up, support, Plut.
to have come back, to return, Dem.
to recount, recapitulate, Hdt.: but perh. ἐπαλιλλόγησα is the true form: v. παλιλ-λογέω.
to bloom, be in flower, Theocr.
metaph. of any thing that forms on the surface, as a salt crust, Hdt.; the down on fruit, Ar., etc.: generally, to be upon the surface, shew itself, appear plainly, Id.
to be bright, Babr.
to deck as with flowers, to make bright-coloured, Luc.:—metaph. to decorate, Aesch.
to plait of or with flowers, Anth.
small fish for frying, small fry, Ar.
to let loose at, τινά τινι Il.
to let go back, relax, Dem.
intr. to relax, leave off doing, c. part., Plat.: absol., ἐπανῆκεν ὁ σῖτος corn fell in price, Dem.
to make quite equal, to balance evenly, equalise, τινα πρός τινα Thuc.: absol. to provide compensation, Plat.
to set up again, Plat.
to make to rise against, Plut.
Pass., with fut. mid., aor2 and perf. act. to stand up after another or at his word, Il.: to rise from bed, Ar.: to rise to speak, Dem.:—of buildings, to be raised, Ar.
to rise up against, rise in insurrection against, τινι Hdt., Thuc.: absol. to rise in insurrection, Id.
one must return to a point, Plat.
a rising up, Plat.
in speaking, recapitulation, Id.

entry.note: fut. ώσω imperf. double augm., ἐπηνώρθουν aor1 double augm., ἐπηνώρθωσα Mid., fut. -ἀνορθώσομαι imperf. ἐπηνωρθούμην aor1 ἐπηνωρθωσάμην Pass., fut. -ανορθωθήσομαι aor1 ἐπηνωρθώθην perf. ἐπηνώρθωμαι
entry.sense: to set up again, restore, Thuc., etc.
to correct, amend, revise, Plat.; so in Mid., Id.
a correction, Plat., Dem.
a correcting, revisal, Dem.
to get up on, mount, Ar.; ἐπαναβεβηκότες mounted on horseback, Hdt.
to go up inland, Thuc.:— to go up, ascend, Xen.
to throw back over: in Mid. to throw back, defer, Hdt.
to make to mount upon, Thuc.
steep, Thuc.
to fall in with others, Hhymn.
to pump over or upon, pour over, Plat.:—Pass. to be filled, Id.
to complete, accomplish, Hes.:— Mid. to procure, Soph.
from above, above, Eur., Thuc.
οἱ ἐπ. men of former time, Theocr.
above, atop, on the upper side or part, Plat.; ὁ ἐπάνω πύργος the upper tower, Hdt.
c. gen. above, Id., Plat.
above, in a book, Lat. supra, Xen.
of Number, above, more than, NTest.
worthy, deserving of, τινος Aesch., Eur.:—c. inf., Soph.
of things, deserved, meet, Aesch., Soph., etc.; κυρεῖν τῶν ἐπαξίων to meet with one's deserts, Aesch.:—so, adv. -ίως, Soph.
worth mentioning, Hdt.
to think right, deem right to do a thing, c. inf., Soph.
to expect, believe, c. acc. et inf., Id.; ἐπ. τινά to deem one worthy of honour, Id.
upon an axle, δίφρος Theocr.

to hold out as a threat to one, τί τινι Hom., Hdt., Soph.:—c. dat. only, to threaten, Il.:—c. inf. to threaten to do, Hdt., Soph.; inf. omitted, ὡς ἐπαπείλησεν as he threatened, Il.:—Pass. to be threatened, Soph.
Mid. to strip and set upon, τινι Plut.
to die after, τινί Plat.
to choke besides:—Pass. aor2 opt., ἐπαποπνῐγείης, may you be choked besides, Ar.
an imprecation, Il.
Dep.:— to imprecate curses upon, τινι Hdt.; ἐπ. λόγον to utter an imprecation, Soph.
to fit to or upon, fasten to, τί τινι Il.
intr. in ionic perf. ἐπάρηρα, plup. ἐπαρήρειν, to fit tight or exactly, to be fitted therein, Id.: ἐπάρμενος, η, ον, epic aor2 pass. part. prepared, Hes.
to dash to, θύραν Plat.
accursed, laid under a curse, Thuc.; ἐπάρατον ἦν μὴ οἰκεῖν there was an imprecation against inhabiting it, Id.
having a film over the eye: metaph. dim, obscure, Aesch.
overlaid with silver, Hdt.
to irrigate, refresh, Luc.
to come to aid, help, τινί Hom., Eur.: absol., aor1 imperat. ἐπαρῆξον Aesch.
towards the left, on the left hand, τὰ ἐπαρίστερα as adv., Hdt.
metaph. lefthanded, awkward, French gauche, Plut.
aid, succour, Soph., Eur.
to ward off a thing from a person, τί τινι Il.
c. acc. rei only, to ward off, prevent, Od.; ἐπ. μὴ πεσεῖν, prohibere quominus, Aesch.
c. dat. pers. only, to help, assist, Hdt., Ar.:—rarely c. acc. pers., like ὠφελεῖν, Eur.:—absol., τίς ἄρ’ ἐπαρκέσει; who will aid? Aesch.
to supply, furnish, τι Id.; ἐπ. τινί τινος to impart to him a share of, Xen.; c. dat. rei, to supply with a thing, Eur.
absol. to be sufficient, to prevail, Soph.
sufficient, Anth.
sufficiently, Soph.
attached to the soil as a serf, ascriptus glebae, Od.
to hang on or over, ἐπ. φόβον τινί Aeschin.: —Pass. to hang over, impend, Lat. imminere, Dem.
ready for work, equipt, Od.
to fit on, Od.
to prepare, Id.:—Mid. to prepare for oneself, Hhymn.
the government of a province, Plut.
provincial, Plut.
a commander, Aesch.
the Roman praefectus, Plut.
to be governor of, τῆς χώρας Xen.; of consular authority, Plut.
to rule in addition to one's own dominions, Xen.
Mid. in the phrase δεπάεσσιν ἐπάρχεσθαι, to begin with the cups, i. e. by offering libations to the gods before the wine was served, Hom.
generally, to offer, Hhymn.
help, aid, against a thing, Luc.
a helper, aider, Od., Eur.
to labour or toil at, finish carefully, Od., etc.
to practise, τέχνην Hdt., Ar.
one upon another, one after another, mostly in pl., Hom.; in sg., κῦμα ὄρνυτ’ ἐπασσύτερον wave upon wave, Il.
following close one upon another, Aesch.
one must enchant, Plat.
to lighten upon, Anth.; ἐπ. πῦρ to flash fire, Id.
Mid. to look at by the light, Anth.
Mid. to call upon, invoke, Soph.
to accompany on the flute, c. dat., Luc.
Pass. to be played on the flute, Eur.
Dep. with aor. mid., to encamp on the field, Thuc.
to encamp near, τινι Plut.
a fold, Id.
a fold for cattle at night, ἔπαυλοι Od.; heterog. pl. ἔπαυλα Soph.
generally, a dwelling, home, Aesch., Soph.
to increase, enlarge, augment, Thuc., Dem.:—Pass. to grow, increase, Xen.
increase, increment, Plat.
fruition, Hdt., Thuc.
to creak besides, Hes.
to shout in applause, Theocr.
Act. to partake of, share, c. gen. rei, Il.
of physical contact, to touch, graze, c. acc., esp. of slight wounds, Id.; also c. gen. to touch, Id.
Mid. to reap the fruits of a thing, whether good or bad:
c. gen., in good sense, Id., Eur.

in bad sense, ἵνα πάντες ἐπαύρωνται βασιλῆος that all may enjoy their king, i. e. feel what it is to have such a king, Il.; c. acc. et gen., τοιαῦτ’ ἐπηύρω τοῦ φιλανθρώπου τρόπου such profit didst thou gain from . . , Aesch.; and absol., μιν ἐπαυρήσεσθαι ὀΐω I doubt not he will feel the consequences, Il.
on or for the neck, Anth.
to exult in or at a thing, c. dat., Soph.
c. inf. to be confident that, Id.
to shout over a thing, c. dat., Aesch.
Pass. to be withered, ἐπαφαυάνθην γελῶν I was quite spent with laughing, Ar.
to touch on the surface, stroke, Aesch.:—Mid., c. gen., Mosch.
touch, touching, handling, Aesch.
to discharge at, c. dat., Xen.
to foam up or on the surface, Mosch.
lovely, charming, Lat. venustus, of persons, Hdt., etc.
used to translate Sulla's epithet Felix, favoured by Venus, i. e. fortune's favourite, Plut.
to pour over, Od.
heavy, ponderous, Ar.
metaph. burdensome, annoying, grievous, Aesch., Plat.
of persons, Thuc., Dem.
Pass. to be annoyed at a thing, c. dat., Eur.
lying like dust upon, Anth.
to laugh at, exult over a person, c. dat., Soph., Xen.; κατά τινος Soph.
to awaken, rouse up, τινά Od., Hdt., etc.:—Pass. to be roused, wake up, Hom., in forms ἐπέγρετο, ἐπεγρόμενος (which are from an epic aor. ἐπ-ηγρόμην).
metaph. to awaken, excite, Solon., Soph.;—Pass., ἐπηγέρθη μῆνις Hdt.
to snap up besides, Ar.
to give an order to others, Eur.
to pour in besides, Aesch., Eur.
ἒ ἔ, or ἒ ἒ ἒ ἔ, an exclamation, woe! woe! Aesch., etc.
Lat. se, v. sub οὗ, sui.
to press down, weigh down, Il.
to press in pursuit, to press hard, press upon, absol. and c. acc., Hom.
to drive on, urge forward, ἐρετμὰ χερσὶν ἔπειγον Od.; of a fair wind, Id., Soph.

to urge on, hurry on a thing, Od., Soph.: —Pass., of a ship, Il.:—Mid. to urge on for oneself, τὸν ἐμὸν γάμον Od.; τὴν παρασκευήν Thuc.:—absol., ἐπειγομένων ἀνέμων by the force of winds, Il.; ὀπὸς γάλα ἐπειγόμενος συνέπηξεν the fig-juice by its force curdled the milk, Id.

Pass. to hurry oneself, haste to do, c. inf., Id.:—absol. to hasten, hurry, speed, make haste, Id., etc.: part., ἐπειγόμενος in eager haste, eagerly, Id.; c. inf., δῦναι ἐπειγόμενος eager for its setting, Od.; c. gen., ἐπειγόμενός περ ὁδοῖο longing for the journey, Id.
intr. in Act., = Pass. to hasten to a place, Soph., Eur.:— τὰ ἐπείγοντα necessary matters, Plut.
i. e. ἐπειδὴ ἄν, = ἐπεάν, ἐπήν whenever.

entry.etym: aor2 with no pres. in use, ἐφοράω being used instead.
entry.sense: to look upon, behold, Il.; also in Mid., Eur., Ar.:—of the gods, to look upon human affairs, Aesch.
to continue to see, i. e. to live to see, Hdt.: to experience, χαλεπά Xen.
Really ἐπεὶ ἦ, since in truth, Hom.
to make like or liken, δάμαρτα τήνδ’ ἐπεικάζων κυρῶ; am I right in identifying her with his wife, i. e. in conjecturing that she is so? Soph.
to conjecture, ὡς ἐπεικάσαι as far as one may guess, Hdt., Soph.
to be upon, c. dat., Il., Aesch.; but in Prose with prep., ἐπὶ τοῦ καταστρώματος Hdt.; ἐπὶ ταῖς οἰκίαις Xen.
to be set upon, Hdt.:—of rewards and penalties, to be affixed or attached, Aesch., etc.
of Time, to be hereafter, remain, Od.; ἐπεσσόμενοι ἄνθρωποι generations to come, Orac. ap. Hdt.:—also to be at hand, Soph., Xen.
to be set over, Lat. praeesse, τισι Hdt.
to be added, be over and above, of numbers, Id.

entry.note: inf. -ιέναι epic 3rd sg. imperf. ἐπήϊεν pl. ἐπήϊσαν ἐπῇσαν attic ἐπῄειν 3rd pl. ἐπῄεσαν fut. ἐπιείσομαι part. fem. aor1 mid. ἐπιεισαμένη
entry.etym: serving in attic as fut. of ἐπέρχομαι
entry.sense: to come upon:
come near, approach, Od.

mostly in hostile sense, to come or go against, attack, assault, c. acc., Il.; c. dat., Id., Hdt., attic; absol., Hom.; οἱ ἐπιόντες the invaders, assailants, Hdt.; but ὁ ἐπιών = ὁ τυχών, the first comer, Soph.
to get on the βῆμα to speak, Thuc.: to come on the stage, Xen.
of events, etc., to come upon one, overtake, c. acc., Il., Aesch.: c. dat. to come near, threaten, Il., etc.
c. dat. pers. to come into one's head, occur to one, Plat., Xen.;—absol., τοὐπιόν what occurs to one, Plat.

of Time, to come on or after: mostly in part. ἐπιών, οῦσα, όν, following, succeeding, instant, ἡ ἐπιοῦσα ἡμέρα the coming day, Hdt.; ὁ ἐπιὼν βίοτος Eur.; τὰ ἐπιόντα the consequences, Dem.; ὁ ἐπιών the successor, Soph.
to go over a space, to traverse, visit, c. acc., Od., Hdt., etc.
to go over, i. e. count over, Od.
haste, hurry, Plut.
conjunct., temporal and causal, like Lat. quum:

OF TIME, after that, after (postquam), since, when (quum), with aor. to express a complete action, or imperf. to express one not yet complete, ἐπεὶ ὑπηντίαζεν ἡ φάλαγξ καὶ ἡ σάλπιγξ ἐφθέγξατο after the phalanx began to advance and the trumpet had sounded, Xen.
= ἐξ οὗ, from the time when, ever since, ἐπείτε παρέλαβον τὸν θρόνον since I came to the throne, Hdt.

with Subjunct., ἄν or κε being added, so that ἐπεί becomes ἐπάν, ἐπήν, ionic ἐπεάν, or ἐπεί κε· — referring to future time, ἐπὴν ἕλωμεν when we shall have taken the city, Il.:—also whenever, ἐπεί κε λίπῃ ὀστέα θυμός Od.
with Opt. without ἄν, referring to future time, ἐπειδὴ πρὸς τὸ φῶς ἔλθοι after he had come into the light, Plat.:—also whenever, ἐπεὶ πύθοιτο Xen.
in oratione obl. after past tenses, representing a subj. in orat. rect., ἐπεὶ διαβαίης, the direct form being ἐπὴν διαβῶ, Id.
with other words, ἐπεὶ τάχιστα, as soon as, Lat. quum primum, Id.; ἐπεὶ εὐθέως Id.; ἐπειδὴ τάχιστα Plat.; ἐπειδὴ θᾶττον Dem.

CAUSAL, since, seeing that, with Ind. or Opt. with ἄν, Hom., etc.; with Imp., ἐπεὶ δίδαξον for teach me, Soph.; ἐπεὶ πῶς ἂν καλέσειας; for how would you call him? Ar.:—sometimes it may be rendered by although, or by else, otherwise.
with other Particles, ἐπεὶ ἄρα, ἐπεὶ ἂρ δή since then, Od.; ἐπεί γε, Lat. quandoquidem, since indeed, Hdt.; ἐπείπερ seeing that, Aesch., etc.; ἐπεί τοι since surely, Soph.
ἐπεί περ, Conj. seeing that, Aesch., etc.
to say besides, Hdt., Thuc.
entry.etym: aor2 with no pres. in use

entry.sense: to bring in besides, to bring in something new, Aeschin.:—Mid. to introduce besides, Plat.
a bringing in besides, a means of bringing or letting in, Thuc.
brought in besides the products of the country; τὰ ἐπ. imported wares, Plat.
brought in besides: brought in from abroad, imported, alien, foreign, Eur., Dem.
to go into upon, ἵππῳ εἰς θάλασσαν Xen.; ἐπ. ἐς τὴν θάλασσαν to go into the sea so as to board ships, Thuc.
to throw into besides, τί τινι Eur.
intr. to invade again, Thuc.
an additional passenger, supernumerary on board ship, Eur.
to come in or besides, in battle, Hdt.: to come next upon the stage, Aeschin.
Dep. with aor. and perf. act.:— to come in besides, Thuc.; as stepmother, Hdt.
to come in after, Id.
to come into beside, c. acc., or dat., Eur.: of things, to be imported, Thuc.
to come into one's head, occur to one, Luc.
to roll or bring in one upon another, Luc.:—Pass. to come in one upon another, Id.
to rush in like revellers, Plat.
coming in besides, adventitious, Plut.
as Subst., an addition, episode, Anth.
a coming in besides, entrance, Soph.
to burst in, εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Ar.
to leap in upon, εἴς τι Xen.; absol., Ar.
to fall in upon, c. dat., Eur., Xen.; c. acc., Eur.:—absol. to burst in, Soph.
to fall upon, of lightning, Hdt.
to sail in after, Thuc., Xen.
to sail against, attack, Thuc.
to flow in upon or besides, Plut., Luc.
to bring in besides or next, Aesch., Ar.:—Mid. to bring in for oneself, Thuc.:— Pass., τὸ ἐπεσφερόμενον πρῆγμα whatever comes upon us, occurs, Hdt.
to introduce besides, Eur.

marks sequence, thereupon, Lat. deinde, when strongly opposed to the former act or state, with past tenses, thereafter, afterwards, with future, hereafter, Hom., etc.; in narrative, πρῶτον μέν . . , followed by ἔπειτα δέ . . , Lat. primum . . , deinde . . , Thuc., etc.; πρὶν μὲν . . , ἔπ. δὲ . . Soph.:—with the Article, τὸ ἔπ. what follows, Id.; οἱ ἔπ. future generations, Aesch.; ὁ ἔπ. βίος Plat.; ἐν τῷ ἔπ. (sc. χρόνῳ) Id.

like εἶτα, with a Verb after a part., μειδήσασα δ’ ἐπ. ἑῷ ἐγκάτθετο κόλπῳ she smiled and then placed it in her bosom, Il.; often to mark surprise or the like, and then, and yet, τὸ μητρὸς αἷμα ἐκχέας ἔπ. δώματ’ οἰκήσεις πατρός; after shedding thy mother's blood, wilt thou yet dwell in thy father's house? Aesch.
after a Temporal Conjunct. then, thereafter ἐπειδὴ σφαίρῃ πειρήσαντο, ὠρχείσθην δὴ ἔπ. when they had done playing at ball, then they danced, Od.

after εἰ or ἤν, then surely, εἰ δ’ ἐτεὸν ἀγορεύεις, ἐξ ἄρα δή τοι ἔπ. θεοὶ φρένας ὤλεσαν if thou speakest sooth, then of a surety have the gods infatuated thee, Il.; so when the apodosis is a question, εἰ κελεύετε, πῶς ἂν ἔπειτ’ Ὀδυσῆος λαθοίμην; how can I in such a case? Id.
of Consequence or Inference, why then, therefore, οὐ σύγ’ ἔπειτα Τύδεος ἔκγονός ἐσσι Id.
to begin a story, well then, Od.

in attic to introduce emphatic questions, why then . . ? ἔπ. τοῦ δέει; Ar.; to express surprise, and so forsooth? and so really? ἔπειτ’ οὐκ οἴει φροντίζειν [τοὺς θεοὺς τῶν ἀνθρώπων]; Xen.; ἔπειτα δῆτα δοῦλος ὢν κόμην ἔχεις; Ar.
to go out upon, disembark, Thuc.
to rush out to aid, Thuc.
to teach or explain besides, Plat.
Dep. to explain besides, Plat.
an excursion, expedition, Thuc.

ἐπ-έκεινα for ἐπ’ ἐκεῖνα, on yonder side, beyond, Lat. ultra, c. gen., Plat., Xen.:—with Article, τὸ ἐπέκεινα, attic τοὐπ., or τὰ ἐπ., attic τἀπ., the part beyond, the far side, τὰ ἐπ. τῆς Εὐρώπης Hdt.; τοὐπ. τῆσδε γῆς beyond it, Eur.: absol., ἐν τῷ ἐπ. on the far side, Thuc.; εἰς τὸ ἐπ. Plat.
to drink off after, Eur.
a sailing out against, an attack by sea, Thuc.
to extend:—Pass. to be extended, reach out towards, τινί NTest.
to sally out upon or against, τινί Xen.
to carry out far, Plut.
to advance next or after, Aesch.
a charge, of cavalry, Plut.
to drive upon, τὰς ἁμάξας ἐπελαύνουσι, i. e. upon the ice, Hdt.
to lay metal beaten out into plates over a surface (cf. ἐλαύνω III. 1), ἐπὶ δ’ ὄγδοον ἤλασε χαλκόν Il.
metaph., ὅρκον ἐπελαύνειν τινί to force an oath upon one, Hdt.
to ride or lead against, ἵππον στρατιήν τινι Xen., Hdt.
intr. to march against, Id.; to charge, Id.: of ships, to drive upon a rock, Id.
to buoy up with hope, to cheat with false hopes, Thuc.
intr. = ἐλπίζω, Eur.
to have hopes of, to hope that . . , c. inf. fut., Hom., Aesch.
step upon step, ascending, Anth.
to step or tread upon, and in perf. to stand upon, c. gen., Il., Soph.: also c. dat., Aesch., etc.; sometimes c. acc., Eur.
to embark on ship-board, Dem.
c. dat. pers. to trample upon, Lat. insultare, Soph., Eur.
τῷ καιρῷ ἐπ. to take advantage of the opportunity, Dem.
to put on, τί τινι Eur.: to throw down upon, δόμους Id.
to throw against, c. acc., Id.
to put in besides, insert, Hdt.:— metaph., σωτῆρα σαυτὸν ἐπεμβάλλεις thou intrudest thyself as saviour, Soph.
intr. to flow in besides, of rivers, Xen.
one mounted, c. gen., Eur.
to trample upon, τινί Ar.
to fall upon besides, attack furiously, τινί Soph.
to fall to, set to work, Lat. incumbere, Ar.
to kill one over another, Soph.
to give over and above, Aesch.
an upper garment, Plut.
to put on one garment over another, Hdt.:—Pass. to have on over, Plut.
to leap upon a thing, c. dat., Aesch.; ἐπ. ἐπί τινα to leap upon one, as an enemy, Soph.
to make fast, Od.
to stretch tight upon: Pass., ἐπενταθείς stretched upon his sword, Soph.
intr. to press on amain, Ar.
to command besides, Soph.
to set right, get ready, Il.; χεῖρα ἐπεντύνειν ἐπί τινι to arm it for the fight, Soph.: —Mid. to prepare or train oneself for, ἄεθλα Od.
to lead out an army against the enemy, Thuc.
intr. (sub. τάξιν) to extend the line of battle (by taking ground to right or left), Id.; so of ships, to extend their line, Id.
extension of a line of battle, Thuc.
to err yet more, one must err yet more, Dem.

entry.etym: serving as attic fut. to ἐπεξέρχομαι
entry.sense: to go out against an enemy, c. dat., Hdt., Thuc.
to proceed against, take vengeance on, Hdt.: in legal sense, to prosecute, τινι Dem.:—also c. acc. pers., Eur., Dem.
to go over, traverse, go through in detail, c. acc., Hdt., Ar.
to go through with, execute, παρασκευάς, τιμωρίας Thuc.
to send on to the attack, ἱππεῖς Xen.
Dep.:
to effect besides, Dem.
to slay over again, Soph.
to go out against, make a sally against, τινι Hdt., Thuc., etc.; of a message, ἐπ. τινι to reach him, Hdt.
to proceed against, prosecute, τινι Thuc., etc.:—c. acc. pers. to punish, Eur.
to proceed to an extremity, Soph., Eur.
c. acc. loci, to go through or over, traverse, Hdt.
to carry out, accomplish, execute, Thuc.; πᾶν ἐπεξ. to try every course.
to discuss, relate or examine accurately or fully, Aesch., Thuc.; ἀκριβείᾳ περὶ ἑκάστου ἐπ. Id.
a fresh review or muster, Thuc.
to invent besides, Hdt.
Dep. to recount in detail, Plut.
to shout in triumph over another, Aesch.
of a march: ἐπεξόδια (sc. ἱερά), τά sacrifices before the march of an army, Xen.
a march out against an enemy, Thuc.

entry.etym: perf. with no pres. in use.
entry.sense: to be like, to suit, c. dat. pers., ὅστις οἵ τ’ ἐπέοικε Il.

mostly impers. it is fit, proper, c. dat. pers. et inf., Id.; νέῳ ἐπέοικε κεῖσθαι 'tis a seemly thing for a young man to lie dead, Id.:—c. acc. pers. et inf., λαοὺς δ’ οὐκ ἐπέοικε ἐπαγείρειν Id.:—c. inf. alone, ἀποδώσομαι ὅσς’ ἐπέοικε [ἀποδόσθαι] Id.:—part. pl. ἐπεικότα, seemly, fit, Aesch.
lovely, amiable, Luc.
Dep. to cultivate besides, encroach upon ground consecrated to a god, Aeschin.
cultivation of another's land, encroachment upon sacred ground, Thuc.
the right of mutual tillage on each other's ground, Xen.
to stimulate, urge on, Plut.

to drive against, drive home, ἔγχος Il.; ἐπέρεισε δὲ ἶν’ ἀπέλεθρον put vast strength to it, Hom.:— ἐπ. τὴν φάλαγγά τινι to bring the whole force of the phalanx against, Plut.:—Mid., λαίφη προτόνοις ἐπερειδόμεναι staying their sails on ropes, Eur.:—Pass. to lean or bear upon, τινι Ar.: absol. to resist with all one's force, Id.
to put a cover upon, deck, Il.
to ask besides or again, Xen.
to question a person besides about a thing, consult him about, τινά τι Hdt.; to enquire of a god, θεόν Id., Thuc.
to pull to a door, Od.: to drag to a place, Id.:—Mid. to draw on one's clothes, Hdt.

entry.note: imperf. ἐπηρχόμην the attic imperf. is ἐπῄειν and the fut. ἔπειμι aor2 ἐπῆλθον epic -ήλῠθον perf. -ελήλυθα
entry.sense: Dep.,
to come upon, come near, come suddenly upon, τινι Hom., Hdt.:— to come to for advice, Lat. adire aliquem, Eur.
in hostile sense, to go or come against, to attack, assault, absol. or c. dat., Il., Eur., etc.; c. acc., τὴν τῶν πέλας ἐπ. to invade it, Thuc.; hence, to visit, reprove, τινα Eur.
to come forward to speak, Id., Thuc.; also, ἐπ. ἐπὶ τὸν δῆμον Hdt.
of conditions, events, etc., to come suddenly upon, ὕπνος ἐπήλυθέ τινα or τινι Od.
c. dat. pers. to come into one's head, occur to one, ἵμερος ἐπῆλθέ μοι ἐπείρεσθαι Hdt.; or impers. c. inf., καί οἱ ἐπῆλθε πταρεῖν it happened to him to sneeze, Id.
of Time, to come on, return, of the seasons, Od.; so, νὺξ ἐπῆλθε Id.
to come in after or over another, of a second wife, Hdt.
to go over or on a space, to traverse, Lat. obire, c. acc., Od.:— of water, to overflow, Hdt.:—so in attic to go the round of, visit, Soph., Eur.
to go through, treat of, recount, Id., Ar.
to go through, execute, Thuc.
to inquire of, question, consult, τὸν θεόν Hdt., Thuc., etc.; τινὰ περί τινος Hdt.:—Pass. to be questioned, asked a question, Thuc.
c. acc. rei, to ask a thing or about a thing, Hdt.:—c. acc. pers. et rei, ἐπ. τοὺς προφήτας τὸ αἴτιον Id.:—absol. to put the question, Dem.
a question, Hdt., Thuc.
a questioning, consulting, Hdt., Thuc.
hasty speech, scurrility, Od.
throwing words about, rash-talking, abusive, scurrilous, Il.
to eat after or with other food, Xen.
to eat up, Ar.
on the hearth, Anth.
annual, yearly, Hdt.: ἐπέτειοι τὴν φύσιν changeful as the seasons, Ar.
annual, lasting for a year, Hdt., Dem.
from year to year, yearly, Od.
to guide to a point: to administer, Aesch.
to make illustrious, Simon.
to shout assent, Il.
c. acc. rei, to sing over or with a thing, c. dat., Aesch., Eur.
c. dupl. acc., ἐπ. παιᾶνα Ἄρτεμιν to sing a paean in praise of her, Id.
Dep.
to pray or make a vow to a deity, c. dat., Hom., Hdt., etc.:—c. inf. to pray to one that . . , Od., etc. :—c. acc. rei, to pray for, Aesch.: also, c. acc. cogn., ἐπ. λιτάς Soph.
to imprecate a curse upon, τί τινι Aesch.; c. inf., ἐπεύχομαι [αὐτῷ] παθεῖν Soph.: absol. to utter imprecations, Id.
to glory over, τινι Il.
to boast that, c. inf., Hhymn., Aesch., etc.
to lower the price of a thing, Dem.

entry.note: fut. ἐφ-έξω aor. ἐπ-έσχον imperat. ἐπίσχες inf. ἐπισχεῖν poet. ἐπ-έσχεθον
entry.sense: to have or hold upon, πόδας θρόνῳ Il.
to hold out to, present, offer, οἶνον Id., Eur.; so c. inf., πιεῖν ἐπέσχον Ar.:— Mid., ἐπισχόμενος (sc. τὴν κύλικα) having put it to his lips, Plat.
to direct towards, τόξα ἐπ. τινί Eur.:—intr. to aim at, attack, τινί Od.; ἐπί τινα Hdt.; ἐπί τινι Thuc.:—aor2 mid. part. ἐπισχόμενος having aimed at him, Od.
ἐπέχειν (sc. τὸν νοῦν), to intend, purpose, c. inf., Hdt.
to stand facing, to face in a line of battle, τινάς Id.
to keep in, hold back, check, Lat. inhibere, Il., Soph., etc.
ἐπέχειν τινά τινος to stop him, hinder him from it, Id., Eur.: so c. inf., ἐπ. τινὰ μὴ πράσσειν τι Soph.:—absol. to stay proceedings, Thuc.
absol. also to stay, stop, wait, pause, Od., Hdt.; ἐπίσχες ἔστ’ ἂν προσμάθῃς Aesch.; ἐπ. ἕως . . Dem.
c. gen. rei, to stop or cease from, ἐπίσχες τοῦ δρόμου Ar.; τῆς πορείας Xen.:—so c. inf. to leave off doing, Id.
to reach or extend over a space, ἑπτὰ δ’ ἐπέσχε πέλεθρα Il.; ὁπόσσον ἐπέσχε πῦρ so far as the fire reached, Id.; aor2 mid., ἐπέσχετο he lay outstretched, Hes.
to occupy a country, τὴν Ἀσίην Hdt., etc.:—of things, ἡ ὀπώρη ἐπέσχεν αὐτούς occupied or engaged them, Id.
absol. to prevail, predominate, of a wind, Id.; of an earthquake, Thuc.
having achieved or gained a thing, c. gen., Od., Hdt., Aesch.; ἐπ. φρενῶν compos mentis, Id.
of things, pertaining to, befitting, c. dat., Theocr.
the long side-planks bolted to the ribs (σταμίνες) of the ship, Od.
to state objections against, τί τινι Hdt.

entry.etym: Deriv. uncertain: that from ἔτος, sufficient the whole year through, will not suit all passages and is not necessary in any.
entry.sense: abundant, ample, sufficient, Od.; πλυνοὶ ἐπ. troughs always full, Id.; ἐπηετανὸν γὰρ ἔχεσκον for they had great store, Id.; ἐπηεταναὶ τρίχες thick, full fleeces, Hes.; ἐπηεταναὶ πλατάνιστοι Theocr.: —neut. as adv. abundantly, Od.
listening or giving ear to a thing, c. gen., Aesch., Plat.; also c. dat., Id.
within hearing, within ear-shot, εἰς ἐπήκοον Xen.

to overshadow:—Mid., τῷ κοινῷ φόβῳ τὸν σφέτερον ἐπηλυγάζεσθαι to throw a shade over (i. e. conceal) one's own fear by that of others, Thuc.; ἐπηλυγάζεσθαί τινα to put him as a screen before one, Plat.
overshadowing, sheltering, Eur.
a coming over one by spells, a bewitching, Hhymn.
an approach, assault, Anth.
one who comes to a place, ἐπήλυδες αὖθις coming back to me, Soph.
an incomer, stranger, foreigner, Lat. advena, opp. to αὐτόχθων, Hdt., Aesch.
alternating, crossing, of door-bolts, Il.
serving for change, χιτῶνες Od.
to bend or bow down, of a corn-field, Il.
Conj. = ἐπεὶ ἄν
on the beach or shore, Anth.
to shout in applause, Il.
lovely, charming, Hom.
to threaten abusively, Hdt.
to deal despitefully with, act despitefully towards, τινί Xen., Dem.:—absol. to be insolent, Xen.
despiteful treatment, spiteful abuse, Lat. contumelia, Dem., etc.; κατ’ ἐπήρειαν by way of insult, Thuc.; ἐν ἐπηρείας τάξει Dem.
at the oar, Od.
equipt with oars, νῆες Id.
overhanging, beetling, of cliffs, Hom.
pass. covered, sheltered, Hes.
affable, gentle, Od.
properly, woven upon, closely woven: then, close-thronged, one upon another, Il.
courtesy, kindness, Od.
to resound, re-echo, Eur.
a ladder or steps: metaph. a means of approach, τινός towards . . , Plut.
a passenger's fare, Lat. naulum, Od.
a roosting-place, perch, Anth.

entry.note: fut. -βήσομαι perf. -βέβηκα aor2 -έβην imperat. ἐπιβῆθι or ἐπίβα aor1 mid., ἐπεβησάμην imperat. ἐπιβήσεο
entry.etym: Hom. always uses the ionic aor1 form ἐπεβήσετο
entry.sense: in fut. and aor. mid., perf. act., and athematic aor., intr., to go upon:
c. gen. to set foot on, tread or walk upon, Hom., attic:—also, ἐπ. ἐπί τινος Hdt.
to get upon, mount on, νεῶν ἵππων Hom., Hdt.;—also, ἐπ. ἐπὶ νηός Id.
of Time, to arrive at, Plat.
metaph., ἐπ’ ἀναιδείης ἐπ. to indulge in impudence, Od.; εὐσεβίας ἐπ. to observe piety, Soph.
c. dat. to mount upon, get upon, ναυσί Thuc.:—also, ἐπ. ἐπὶ πύργῳ Hdt.
c. dat. pers. to set upon, attack, assault, τινί Xen.
c. acc. loci, to light upon, Hom.: simply, to go on to a place, to enter it, Hdt.
c. acc. to attack, like ἐπέρχομαι, Soph. :dnum [3.] to mount, νῶθ’ ἵππων Hes.; ἵππον Hdt.
absol. to get a footing, Od.
to step onwards, advance, Hes., Soph.
to mount on a chariot or on horseback, be mounted, Il., Hdt.: to go or be on board ship, Il., Soph., etc.
Causal in aor1 act. (ἐπιβιβάζω serves as pres.), to make one mount, set him upon, ἵππων ἐπέβησε Il.; πυρῆς ἐπέβησε Id.
metaph., εὐκλεΐης ἐπίβησον bring to great glory, Id.; σαοφροσύνης ἐπέβησαν they bring him to sobriety, Od.
trans. to throw or cast upon, Lat. injicere, τρίχας ἐπ. (sc. πυρί) Il.; ἐπ. ἑωυτὸν ἐς τὸ πῦρ Hdt.
to lay on, Lat. applicare, [ἵπποις] ἐπέβαλλεν ἱμάσθλην Od.; ἐπιβ. πληγάς τινι Xen.:— to lay on as a tax, tribute, fine or penalty, τί τινι Hdt., attic
ἐπιβ. σφραγῖδα to affix a seal, Hdt.
to add, ἐπ. (sc. χοῦν) to throw on more and more earth, Thuc.:—metaph. to mention, Lat. mentionem injicere rei, τι Soph.
intr. (sub. ἑαυτόν), to throw oneself upon, go straight towards, c. acc., Od.
to fall upon or against, τινί Plat.
(sub. τὸν νοῦν) to apply oneself to a thing, devote oneself to it, c. dat., Plut.: to give one's attention to, think on, NTest.
to follow, come next, Plut.

to belong to, fall to, τινί Hdt., Dem.:—also impers. c. acc. et inf. it falls to one's very lot, it concerns one to do a thing, Hdt.:— τὸ ἐπιβάλλον (sc. μέρος) the portion that falls to one, Id., NTest.
Mid., c. gen., to throw oneself upon, desire eagerly, Il.
c. acc. to put upon oneself, Eur.: metaph. to take possession of, take upon oneself, Thuc.
in Pass. to be put upon, ἐπιβεβλημένοι τοξόται archers with their arrows on the string, Xen.
a stepping upon, approaching: a means of approach, access, Plat.; εἴς τινα ποιεῖσθαι ἐπ. to find a means of attacking one, Hdt.
c. gen., κακῶν ἐπιβασκέμεν υἷας Ἀχαιῶν to lead them into misery, Il.
to weigh in the hand, Eur.
to set one foot upon a place, c. gen., Plut.:—metaph. to take one's stand upon, οὐνόματος ἐπ. to usurp a name, Hdt.; ῥήματος ἐπ. to rely upon a word, Id.
to be a soldier on board ship, Id.
one who mounts or embarks;
ἐπιβάται, οἱ, the soldiers on board ship, the fighting men, as opp. to the rowers and seamen, Hdt.
a merchant on board ship, supercargo, Dem.
the fighting man in a chariot, Plat.
that can be climbed, accessible, Hdt.; χρυσίῳ ἐπ. accessible to a bribe, Plut.
to cough after or besides, Hipp.
one who mounts, ἐπ. ἵππων a mounted horseman, Od.
of male animals, e. g. a boar, Id.; a bull, Theocr.
to put one upon, τοὺς ὁπλίτας ἐπὶ τὰς ναῦς Thuc.
to live over or after, survive, Thuc.
to look upon, look attentively, εἴς τινα Plat.; τινί Luc.
c. acc. to look well at, observe, Plat.
to eye with envy, Lat. invidere, c. dat., Soph.
a looking at, gazing, Plut.
that which is thrown over, tapestry, hangings, Plut.
that which is put on, a patch, NTest.
a bar fitting into a socket, Il.
to well or gush forth, Anth.
to call upon or to, cry out to, ἐπ. τινὶ ὅτι . . , or c. inf., Thuc.
to utter or sing aloud over, τί τινι Ar.:—so in Mid., Id.
to cry out against, τινά: Pass. ἐπιβοώμενος cried out against, Id.
to invoke, call upon, θεούς Od.; so in Mid., ἐπιβοᾶσθαι Θέμιν Eur.:— to call to aid, τὴν στρατιὴν ἐπεβώσαντο Hdt.
a coming to aid, succour, Thuc., Xen.
to come to aid, to succour, τινί Hdt., Thuc.
a call or cry to one, Thuc.
cried out against, ill spoken of, Thuc.
a throwing or laying on, ἱματίων Thuc.; χειρῶν σιδηρῶν of grappling-irons, Id.
a hostile attempt, Plut.
that which is laid on, ἐπιβολαὶ πλίνθων layers or courses of bricks, Thuc.
a penalty, fine, Ar., Xen.:— an impost, public burden, Plut.
to roar in answer to or after, τινί Luc.
Mid., of cattle, to graze or feed upon, τινι Batr.
to feed among the herd, c. dat., Mosch.
an over-herdsman, Od.
a plot, attempt, scheme, Thuc.
one who plots against, c. gen., Soph.

to plan or contrive against, κακὸν πόλει Tyrtae.; θάνατόν τινι Hdt.:—c. dat. pers. only, to plot against, lay snares for, τῇ πόλει Aesch.; τῷ πλήθει Ar.;—absol., οὑπιβουλεύων the conspirer, Soph.: —c. acc. rei only, to plan secretly, scheme, plot, τὸν ἔκπλουν Thuc.
c. dat. rei, to form designs upon, aim at, πρήγμασι μεγάλοισι Hdt.; τυραννίδι Plat.
c. inf. to purpose or design to do, Hdt., Thuc.
Pass., with fut. mid. -εύσομαι: aor1 -εβουλεύθην:— to have plots formed against one, to be the object of plots, Id.
of things, to be designed against, πρᾶγμα, ὃ τοῖς θεοῖς ἐπιβουλεύεται Ar.; τὰ ἐπιβουλευόμενα plots, Xen.
a plan against another, a plot, Hdt., Thuc.
plotting against, τινι Plat.: treacherous, Xen.
to make to roar, Il.:—Mid. to roar, Ar.
c. acc. cogn. to roar out, Eur.
falling heavy upon, Aesch.

to fall heavy upon, fall heavily, of rain, Il.; in good sense, ὁππότε δὴ Διὸς ὧραι ἐπιβρίσειαν when the seasons produce heavy crops, Od.: —metaph., of war, Il.; of persons, ἐπέβρισαν ἀμφὶ ἄνακτα pressed closely round him, Id.
to thunder in response, Plut.
frantic, Soph.
to gnash, Anth.
to burst forth, of flowers, Theocr.
to stop up, τὸ στόμα τινός Ar.:— Mid., ἐπιβύσασθαι τὰ ὦτα to stop one's ears, Luc.
on or at the altar, Eur.; ἐπιβώμια ῥέζειν Theocr.

entry.etym: as if from a Subst. ἐπιβωμιοστάτης
entry.sense: to stand suppliant at the altar, Eur.
to shout to, call upon, τινά Theocr.
an over-shepherd, Od.
upon the earth, τὰ ἐπίγαια the parts on or near the ground, Hdt.
to marry as the next of kin, γυναῖκα NTest.
to marry besides, ἐπ. πόσει πόσιν to wed one husband after another, Eur.; ἐπ. τέκνοις μητρυιάν to marry and set a step-mother over one's children, Id.
= Lat. connubium, the right of intermarriage between states, Xen.:—generally, intermarriage, Hdt., Xen.
marriageable, Hdt., Dem.
Pass. to exult in, τινι Xen.
to shout in applause, Il.
terrestrial, Plat.
to laugh approvingly, Lat. arrideo, Il., attic
= ἐπεγγελάω, Luc.
to give honour to, τινά Xen.
to rejoice or triumph over, τινί Aesch.

entry.note: ionic and later -γίνομαι fut. -γενήσομαι aor. -εγενόμην perf. -γέγονα
entry.sense: of Time, to be born after, come into being after, ἔαρος δ’ ἐπιγίγνεται ὥρῃ other [leaves] come on in spring time, Il.; οἱ ἐπιγιγνόμενοι ἄνθρωποι posterity, Hdt.; οἱ ἐπιγενόμενοι τούτῳ σοφισταί who came after him, Id.; τῇ ἐπιγενομένῃ ἡμέρᾳ the following day, Thuc.; χρόνου ἐπιγιγνομένου as time went on, Hdt., Thuc.
of events, to come upon, be incident to, Lat. supervenire, χειμών, νὺξ ἐπεγένετο Hdt.; ἄνεμος ἐπεγένετο τῇ φλογί seconded the flame, Thuc.; τὰ ἐπιγιγνόμενα each in succession, Id.
to come in after, ἐπὶ τῇ ναυμαχίῃ Hdt.: to come upon, assault, attack, τινι Thuc.
to befall, come to pass, Id.

entry.note: ionic and later -γῑνώσκω fut. -γνώσομαι aor2 ἐπ-έγνων epic 3rd pl. subj. ἐπιγνώωσι perf. ἐπέγνωκα
entry.sense: to look upon, witness, observe, Od., Xen.
to recognise, know again, Od., Soph.: to acknowledge or approve a thing, NTest.
of things, also to find out, discover, detect, Aesch., Thuc.
to come to a decision, to resolve, decide, τι περί τινος Id.
Dep., to throw forth ill language, utter abuse, Aesch.: c. gen. to vent reproaches against a person, Id.
curved, twisted, Hhymn.
to bend towards one, Il.:—metaph. to bow or bend to one's purpose, Id.
to clean clothes: to vamp up, Luc.
an arbiter, umpire, judge, c. gen. rei, Plat.; ἐπ. τῆς τιμῆς an appraiser, Dem.
= συγγνώμων, pardoning, τινί Mosch.
to make known, announce, Xen.
full knowledge, NTest.
increase, growth, produce, Plut., Luc.
born besides:—as Subst., ἐπίγονοι, οἱ, offspring, posterity, Aesch.: a breed [of bees], Xen.
οἱ Ἐπίγονοι the afterborn, sons of the chiefs who fell in the first war against Thebes, Hdt.
the Successors to Alexander's dominions.
the part above the knee, the great muscle of the thigh, μεγάλην ἐπιγουνίδα θεῖτο he would grow a stout thigh-muscle, Od.
scraping the surface, grazing, Lat. strictim, Il.
an inscription, Hdt., Thuc.:—esp. in verse, an epigram, commonly in Elegiacs.
a written estimate of damages, Dem.
an inscription, στηλῶν on stones, Thuc.
to mark the surface, just pierce, graze, ὀϊστὸς ἐπέγραψε χρόα Il.
to mark, put a mark on the lot, Id.—In Hom. the word has not any notion of writing.
to write upon, inscribe, Hdt.:—Pass., of the inscription, to be inscribed upon, Id.; also, ἐπεγράφου τὴν Γοργόνα hadst the Gorgon painted on thy shield, Ar.
in attic law phrases:
to set down the penalty or damages in the title of an indictment, Id.; τὰ ἐπιγεγραμμένα the damages claimed, Dem.:—so in Mid., Aeschin.
to register, Oratt.:—Mid. to have one's name registered, Thuc.; also, ἐπεγράψαντο πολίτας had them registered as citizens, Id.
προστάτην ἐπιγράψασθαι to choose a patron, and have his name entered in the public register, as all μέτοικοι at Athens were obliged to do, Ar.;—so, ἐπιγράψασθαί τινα κύριον Dem.
ἐπιγράψαι ἑαυτὸν ἐπί τι to lend one's name to a thing, to endorse it, Aeschin.;—so in Pass. and Mid., to inscribe one's name on, Id.
Mid. to assume a name, Plut.
somewhat hooked, of the beak of the ibis, Hdt.; of men, Plat.
Dep. to kindle at, metaph., delight greatly at.
Dep. to distribute, Hhymn.:— Pass., perf. δέδασμαι, Hes.
to weep over, absol., Ar.
Mid. to subdue, Anth.
to lend money on property already mortgaged, Dem.:—Mid. to borrow on such property, Id.
Dep. to lavish upon a person, bestow freely, τί τινι Hdt.; ἐπιδ. τινί τινος to give him freely of it, Xen.:—metaph. to illustrate more richly, Luc.
in want of, τινος Plat., Xen.:— comp., ἐπιδεέστερος ἐκείνων inferior to them, Plat.: Sup. έστατος Id.
a specimen, pattern, Xen., Plat.
at even, about evening; neut. ἐπιδείελα as adv., Hes.
to exhibit as a specimen, Ar.: generally, to shew forth, display, exhibit, Plat., Xen., etc.

Mid. to shew off or display for oneself or what is one's own, Hdt., Plat., etc.; ἐπιδείξασθαι λόγον to exhibit one's eloquence, Id.:—absol. to shew off, make a display of one's powers, Ar., Plat., etc.
to shew, point out, τί τινι Id.:—c. part. to shew that a thing is, Hdt., etc.; also in Mid., Xen.; ἐπ. τινὰ δωροδοκήσαντα to prove that one took bribes, Ar.
absol. to lay informations, Id.
one must display, Xen., etc.
fit for displaying, c. gen., Luc.; ἡ ἐπιδεικτική display, Lat. ostentatio, Plat.
ἐπιδ. λόγοι speeches for display, declamations, Dem., etc.:—adv. -κῶς, Plut.
a shewing forth, making known, ἐς ἐπίδεξιν ἀνθρώπων ἀπίκετο became notorious, Hdt.
an exhibition, display, Thuc.; ἐπ. ποιεῖσθαι to make a demonstration, in military sense, Id.; ἐλθεῖν εἰς ἐπίδειξίν τινι to come to display oneself to one, Ar.
a show-off speech, declamation, Thuc., Plat., etc.
an example, Lat. specimen, Eur., Aeschin.
to eat at second course, eat as a dainty, Ar.
one in ten: τὸ ἐπιδέκατον the tenth, tithe, Xen., Dem., etc.
on the bed or bed-clothes, Eur.
towards the right, i. e. from left to right:
neut. pl. as adv., ὄρνυσθ’ ἑξείης ἐπιδέξια rise in order beginning with the left hand man, Od.: —hence auspicious, lucky, ἀστράπτων ἐπιδέξια Il.
after Hom., on the right hand, Xen.; τἀπιδέξια the right side, Ar.
as adj., of persons, dexterous, capable, clever, Aeschin., etc.
dexterity, cleverness, Aeschin.
Dep. to look upon, behold, τινα Hes.
to bind up, Anth.
an upper or outer bandage, Ar.
to be lord over, στρατοῦ Aesch.
in need or want of, c. gen., Hom., Hdt.: absol. in want, Il.
lacking, failing in a thing, c. gen., Od.; βίης ἐπιδευέες Ὀδυσῆος inferior to U. in strength, Id.; absol., ἐπιδευέες ἦμεν too weak were we, Id.
to be in want of, to lack a thing, c. gen., Hom., Hdt.: to need the help of, c. gen. pers., Il.
to be lacking in, fall short of a thing, c. gen., Id.: also c. gen. pers., κείνων ἐπιδεύεαι ἀνδρῶν fallest short of them, Id.; or both together, μάχης ἐπιδεύετ’ Ἀχαιῶν Id.
to moisten, Anth.
Dep. to admit besides or in addition, Hdt.: to allow of, admit of, Lat. recipere, Dem.
to bind or fasten on, τὸν λόφον Ar.; and in Mid., λόφους ἐπιδέεσθαι to have crests fastened on, Hdt.
to bind up, bandage: — Pass., ἐπιδεδεμένος τὰ τραύματα with one's wounds bound up, Xen.; ἐπιδεδεμένοι τὴν χεῖρα Id.
to want or lack of a number, τετρακοσίας μυριάδας, ἐπιδεούσας ἑπτὰ χιλιαδέων 4, 000, 000 lacking 7000, Hdt.
Mid., like epic ἐπιδεύομαι, to be in want of, τινος Id., Xen.
seen clearly, manifest, Hdt.
distinguished, remarkable, Xen.
like, resembling, τινι Ar.
to live among the people, live in the throng, opp. to living in the country, Od.
to be at home, live at home, opp. to ἀποδημέω, Thuc., Xen.
to come home from foreign parts, Id., Aeschin.
of foreigners, to stay in a place, ἐν τόπῳ Xen.; ἐπ. τοῖς μυστηρίοις to attend them, Dem.:—absol. to be in town, Plat.
a stay in a place, Plat., Xen.
among the people, ἐπιδήμιοι ἁρπακτῆρες plunderers of one's own countrymen, Il.; πόλεμος ἐπ. civil war, Id.; ἐπιδήμιον εἶναι to be at home, Od.; ἐπ. ἔμποροι resident merchants, Hdt.
magistrates sent annually by Doric states to their colonies, Thuc.
ἐπίδᾱμος φάτις, doric popular, current report, Soph.
to cross over after another, Hdt.; ἐπ. τάφρον Thuc.; ποταμόν Xen.
to consider anew, Hdt.
to divide anew:—Mid. to distribute among themselves, Hdt.
to decide as umpire, Plat.
Pass. to burst at or because of a thing, Ar.
Mid. to add an order, NTest.
Mid. to deposit as security, Dem.
Pass. to go across after, Thuc.
to teach besides, Xen.
to give besides, τί τινι Il., Hdt., attic
to give in dowry, Il., Xen.
to give freely, Thuc., Ar.:—esp. to contribute as a "benevolence, " for state necessities, opp. to εἰσφέρειν (which was compulsory), Xen., Dem.; cf. ἐπίδοσις.
Mid. to take as witness, θεοὺς ἐπιδώμεθα Il.; (others take it to be ἐπ-ιδώμεθα let us look to the gods).
intr. to increase, advance, ἐς ὕψος Hdt.; ἐπὶ τὸ μεῖζον Thuc., etc.; absol. to grow, wax, advance, improve, Id.
Dep.
to inquire besides, to go on to inquire, Hdt.
to seek for or demand besides, Id.; so, ἐπιδίζομαι, Mosch.
to adjudge property to one, of the judge, Dem.:—Pass., ἐπιδεδικασμένου τὸν κλῆρον having had it adjudged to one, Id.
Mid., of the claimant, to go to law to establish one's claim, Plat.
c. gen. to sue for, claim at law, Dem., etc.
disputed at law:— ἐπίδικος, an heiress, whose hand is claimed by her next of kin, Oratt.
generally, disputed, Plut.
to whirl or swing round before throwing, Hom.:—Mid. to turn over in one's mind, revolve, Od.:—Pass., aor1 ἐπεδινήθην, to wheel about, as birds in the air, Id.
Mid. to set in order also, NTest.
to redouble, Aesch.
the rail upon the car, Il.
on the car, Od.
to pursue after, τινά Hdt.
of persons, likely or expected to do or be so and so, c. inf., ἐπίδοξοι πείσεσθαι likely to suffer, Hdt.
of things, likely, probable, c. inf., ἐπ. γενέσθαι Id.: absol., κακὰ ἐπίδοξα such as might be expected, Id.
for use after dinner, Theocr.
a giving over and above, a voluntary contribution to the state, a "benevolence, " Dem.
（ἐπιδίδωμι intr.) increase, growth, advance, progress, Plat., etc.
to make a noise or clashing, τινι with a thing, Plut.
the reception of something new, Thuc.
Dep. to lay hold of, τινος Plut.
a sudden inroad, a raid, attack, Thuc.; ἐξ ἐπιδρομῆς ἁρπαγή plundering by means of an inroad, i. e. a plundering inroad, Hdt.; hence, ἐξ ἐπιδρομῆς on the sudden, off-hand, Dem.
a place to which ships run in, a landing-place, Eur.
that may be overrun, τεῖχος ἐπ. a wall that may be scaled, Il.; ἐπίδρ. Ζεφύροισι overrun by the W. winds, Anth.
ἐπίδρομος, ὁ, a cord which runs along the upper edge of a net, Xen.
to set upon an action, so as to interrupt it, Il., NTest.
reasonableness, fairness, equity, Thuc., Plat., etc.: clemency, goodness, Dem.
like, resembling, τινι Hom.
fitting, meet, suitable, τύμβον ἐπιεικέα meet in size, Il.; ἐπιεικέ’ ἀμοιβήν a fair recompence, Od.; ὡς ἐπιεικές as is meet, Hom.; c. inf., ὅν κ’ ἐπιεικὲς ἀκούειν which word it is meet to hear, Il.
after Hom.,
of statements, rights, etc.,
reasonable, specious, plausible, Hdt., Thuc.
fair, equitable, τῶν δικαίων τὰ ἐπιεικέστερα προτιθέασι Hdt.; πρὸς τὸ ἐπ. = ἐπιεικῶς 3, Thuc.
of persons, able, capable, Hdt., Xen.
in moral sense, reasonable, fair, kind, gentle, good, Thuc., Plat., etc.: τοὐπιεικές goodness, Soph.
adv. -κῶς, ionic -κέως, fairly, tolerably, moderately, Lat. satis, Hdt., Ar.; τέως μὲν ἐπ. for some little time, Plat.
probably, reasonably, Id.
with moderation, kindly, Plut.
yielding: with negat. unyielding, unflinching, Hom.; ἔργα οὐκ ἐπιεικτά not yielding, harsh, Od.

entry.note: epic for ἐφ-έννυμι aor1 ἐπί-εσσα Med. Ion. pres. inf. ἐπ-είνυσθαι aor1 ἐπι-εσσάμην Pass., 3rd sg. perf. ἐπί-εσται part. ἐπι-ειμένος
entry.sense: to put on besides or over, Od.: Pass., perf. part. metaph., ἐπιειμένος ἀλκήν clad in strength, Il., etc.; χαλκὸν ἐπιέσται has brass upon or over it, Orac. ap. Hdt.:—Mid. to put on oneself besides, put on as an upper garment or covering, Il., Hdt.
vehement, violent, Il.:—adv. ἐπιζαφελῶς (as if from ἐπιζαφελής), vehemently, furiously, Hom.
entry.etym: The simple ζάφελος never occurs: it is connected with the Prefix ζα-.

entry.sense: to overlive, survive, Hdt., Plat.
to join at top, Hdt., Plut.: simply to bind fast, Theocr.
to join to, Lat. adjungere, Aesch.:—metaph. in Pass., μηδ’ ἐπιζευχθῇς στόμα φήμαις πονηραῖς nor let thy mouth be given to evil sayings, Id.
towards the west:—the Italian Locrians were called Ἐπιζεφύριοι, Hdt.
to boil overmetaph., ἡ νεότης ἐπέζεσε my youthful spirit boiled over, Hdt.; κέντρ’ ἐπιζέσαντα, of the poison working out of the skin, Soph.; πῆμα Πριαμίδαις ἐπέζεσε Eur.
Causal, to make to boil, heat, c. acc., ἐπιζεῖν λέβητα Id.
enviable, happy, Aesch.
bringing loss upon, hurtful, prejudicial, Thuc., Xen.
penal: —ἐπιζήμια, τά, penalties, Dem.
liable to punishment, Aeschin.
to mulct, στατῆρι κατὰ τὸν ἄνδρα every man a stater, Xen.
to seek after, wish for, miss, Lat. desiderare, τινά Hdt.; ἐπ. τινά to make further search for him, Dem.:—absol., οἱ ἐπιζητοῦντες the beaters for game, Xen.
to gird on:—Pass., ἐπεζωσμέναι with their clothes girt on so as to leave the breast bare, Hdt.; ἐπεζωσμένος ἐγχειρίδιον girt with a dagger, Xen.
pleasing, acceptable, Od.
assisting against, c. gen., Anth.: defending, governing, also c. gen., Id.
acceptable gifts, Soph., Anth.
nuptial, Luc.: as Subst., ἐπιθαλάμιος, ὁ or ἡ (sub. ὕμνος or ᾠδή), the bridal song, Theocr., Luc.
lying or dwelling on the coast, Lat. maritimus, Hdt., Thuc.
sick to death, at death's door, Dem.
to put trust in, τινί Plut.
to cheer on, encourage, τινά Il., Plut.
to pay honour to, τινά Ar.
ἐπιθεάζων with imprecations, Plat.
to call upon in the name of the gods, to adjure, conjure, Lat. obtestari per deos, Thuc.
to lend inspiration, τινί Plut.
an appeal to the gods, Thuc.
to serve diligently, work zealously for, τι Thuc.
a laying on, τῶν χειρῶν NTest.
(from Mid.) a setting upon, attack, Xen.
of the Pythian Priestess, to prophesy or divine upon, τῷ τρίποδι Hdt.
one must impose, δίκην Plat.
one must set to work at, τινί Id.
ready to attack, θηρίοις Xen.: enterprising, Id.
added, assumed, Plut.
to run at or after, Hdt., Xen.
an addition, increase, Hes.: acc. as adv., κἀπιθήκην τέτταρας and 4 drachmas into the bargain, Ar.
something put on, a lid, cover, Il., Hdt.
a sepulchral figure, Plut.
to touch on the surface, touch lightly, c. gen., Plut.
to sit as a suppliant at an altar, Aesch., Eur.
to shout to, Lat. acclamare, in token either of approval or of displeasure, Xen.
to break besides, Anth.
to lament over, c. acc., Babr.
to leap upon a ship, c. gen., Il.: also c. dat. to leap (contemptously) upon, Lat. insultare, τύμβῳ ἐπιθρώσκων Μενελάου Id.
to leap over, τόσσον ἐπιθρώσκουσι so far do [the horses] spring at a bound, Id.

to set one's heart upon a thing, lust after, long for, covet, desire, c. gen., Hdt., Aesch., etc.; also c. gen. pers., Xen.:—c. inf. to desire to do, Hdt., Soph.:—absol. to desire, covet, Thuc., etc.; τὸ ἐπιθυμοῦν τοῦ πλοῦ = ἐπιθυμία, eagerness for it, Id.
an object of desire, Xen.
one who longs for or desires a thing, c. gen., Hdt., etc.
absol. a lover, Xen.
desiring, coveting, lusting after a thing, c. gen., Plat., etc.:—adv., ἐπιθυμητικῶς ἔχειν τινός = ἐπιθυμεῖν, Id.
an incense-offering, Soph.
to offer incense, Plut.
to guide straight, direct, Soph.
to sacrifice besides or after, Aesch., Eur.:—so in Mid., Plut.
to offer incense on the altar; generally to offer, Ar.
to rush eagerly at, Od.
c. inf. to strive vehemently to do a thing, Il., Hhymn.
desire, yearning, longing, Hdt., Plat., etc.; ἐπιθυμίᾳ by passion, opp. to προνοίᾳ, Thuc.
c. gen. a longing after a thing, desire of or for it, Id., etc.; so, ἐπ. πρός τι Id.
Mid. to put on one's armour, Xen.
to shout aloud, give loud commands, Aesch.; ἐπεθώϋξας τοῦτο didst urge this upon us, Id.
privy to a thing, c. gen., Od.
acquainted with, practised in a thing, c. gen., Anth.
to pull down or destroy besides, Thuc.
to sleep upon, τινί Luc.
Pass. to sit upon, τινι Hdt., Ar.: to press upon, be heavy upon, ἐπί τινι Id.
ἐπ. ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης to sit at his counter, of a money-changer, Dem.
to sit down against a place, besiege it, Thuc.
to set upon, τινὰ ἐπί τι Hipp.:—Mid., aor. 2 -καθέζομην, φυλακὴν ἐπεκαθίσαντο had a guard set, Thuc.
intr. to sit upon, light upon, Plut.
to innovate upon, Aesch.
Dep. to surpass, excel, c. acc., Il.
as Pass. to be adorned or furnished with a thing, c. dat., Id.
= ἐπίκαιρος, Xen.
important, οἱ ἐπικαιριώτατοι the most important officers, Id.; c. inf., οἱ θεραπεύεσθαι ἐπικαίριοι those whose cure is all-important, Id.

in fit time or place, in season, seasonable, opportune, convenient, Soph., Thuc.; of places, ἐπικαιρότατον χωρίον ἀποχρῆσθαι most convenient to use, Id.; τοὺς ἐπικαίρους τῶν τόπων Dem.:—also c. gen., λουτρῶν ἐπίκαιρος convenient for . . , Soph.
of parts of the body, vital, Xen.
to light up a place, πῦρ Hhymn.: to burn on an altar, μηρία Hom.
Dep. to glean after the reapers, Luc.
to call upon a god, invoke, appeal to, Hdt., Dem.; ἐπ. θεόν τινι to invoke a god, to watch over him, Hdt.:—so in Mid., Id., Xen.
to invite, Od.; in Mid., Hdt.
Mid. to call in as a helper or ally, Id., Thuc.
Mid. to call before one, summon, of the Ephors, Hdt.
Mid. to challenge, Id.
Pass. to be called by surname, Id.: to be nicknamed, Xen.
to bring as an accusation against, τί τινι Thuc.; ταῦτ’ ἐπικαλεῖς; is this your charge? Ar.:—Pass., τὰ ἐπικαλεύμενα χρήματα the money he was charged with having, Hdt.
to cover over, cover up, shroud, Hes., Plat.
to put as a covering over, βλεφάρων ἐπ. φᾶρος Eur.
the bend, return or angle of a building, Hdt.; ἐπ. ποιεῖσθαι to draw up their army angular-wise, i. e. with the wings advanced at angles with the centre, so as to take the enemy in flank, Xen.
curved, curling, Plut., Luc.
to bend into an angle:—Pass. to move the wings of an army forward, so as to form angles with the centre and take the enemy in flank, Xen.
crooked, curved, Hhymn.
head-foremost, v. κάρ II.
the usufruct of a property, revenue, profit, opp. to the principal (τὰ ἀρχαῖα), Dem.
on fruit, Anth.

athwart, cross-wise, at an angle, esp. at a right angle, Od., Hdt.; τὰ ἐπικάρσια the country measured along the coast, opp. to τὰ ὄρθια (at right angles to the coast), Id.:—c. gen., τριήρεας τοῦ Πόντου ἐπικαρσίας forming an angle with the current of the Pontus, Id.
to go down to a place, Hdt., Thuc.
to go down against an enemy, Id.
to let fall down at a thing, τὰ ὦτα Xen.
Pass. to come to land along with or afterwards, Thuc.
to fall asleep afterwards, Thuc., Plat.
intr. to sink down upon, τινί Plut.
to overflow besides, τὴν Ἀσίην Hdt.
Dep. to sleep upon, Hdt.
to catch up, overtake, τινά Thuc., Plat.
money paid for exchange, discount, Theophr.
to tarry longer, Xen.
to throw oneself upon, Luc.
yet more accursed, NTest.
to fall down upon, τινί Plut.
Pass. to fall violently down, Plut.
to throw down after, Xen.
to slay upon or over, τινὰ τῷ νεκρῷ, ἑαυτὸν τῷ τύμβῳ Hdt.
to carry the workings of a mine beyond one's boundaries, Dem.
Dep. to tell lies besides, Hdt., Thuc.
to go down into, Thuc.
to detain still, Luc.
burnt at the end, Lat. praeustus, Hdt.
serving as Pass. to ἐπιτίθημι, to be laid upon:
of doors, to be put to or closed, Od., Theogn.
to be placed in or on, c. dat., Hes., Theocr.
of islands, νῆσοι ἐπὶ Λήμνου ἐπικείμεναι lying off Lemnos, Hdt.; so, ἐπ. τῇ Θρηΐκῃ Id.; αἱ νῆσοι αἱ ἐπικείμεναι the islands off the coast, Thuc.
to press upon, be urgent in intreaty, Hdt.: to press upon a retreating enemy, c. dat., Id., Ar., etc.
to hang over, Lat. imminere, c. dat., Xen.; of penalties, θάνατος ἡ ζημίη ἐπικέαται the penalty imposed is death, Hdt.; ζημία ἐπέκειτο στατήρ Thuc.
c. acc. rei, ἐπικείμεναι κάρα κυνέας having their heads covered with helmets, Eur.; πρόσωπον ἐπικείμενος under an assumed character, Plut.
to cut off, cut down, Il.
metaph. to cut short, Lat. praecidere, Id.
to shout to, shout in applause, Il.
a cheering on, exhortation, Thuc.
to encourage besides, to cheer on again, absol. or c. dat., Eur.; also c. acc. pers., Thuc.
to bring to shore, Lat. appellere, Od.
absol. to run ashore, Id.
Dep. to call upon, τινα Il.
to apply the spur, Anth.
to mix in addition, Od.
to gain in addition, Plut.
profit on traffic or business, Hdt.
to mock, ἐπικερτομέων in mockery, Hom.; in milder sense, laughingly, Il.
c. acc. to reproach one, Hdt.:— to teaze, plague, Theocr.
to conceal, hide, Hom.
of or at a burial, funeral, Eur.; ἐπικήδειον, ου, τό, a dirge, elegy, Plut.
subject to death, perishable, Arist.
the sending an embassy to treat for peace, entering into negotiation, Dem.
a demand by herald, Eur.
Dep. to send a message by a herald, τινι or πρός τινα Hdt.; ὥς τινα Thuc.:— c. dat. et inf. to send a message calling on them to do a thing, Id.; ἐπικηρυκευομένων messages being sent, Id.
to send ambassadors to treat for peace, to make proposals for a treaty of peace, Hdt., Thuc.
of private affairs, to negociate, τινι with one, Dem.
to announce by proclamation, Aesch., in Pass.
of penalties, ἐπ. θάνατον τὴν ζημίαν to proclaim death as the penalty, Xen.; ἐπ. ἀργύριον ἐπί τινι to set a price on his head, Hdt.
to offer as a reward, Plut.
to put up to public sale, Id.
to spread over, Orac. ap. Hdt.:—Pass., ὕδωρ ἐπικίδναται αἶαν is spread over the earth, Il.; ὅσον τ’ ἐπικίδναται ἠώς far as the morning light is spread, Id.
Pass. to be risked, Dem.

in danger, dangerous, insecure, precarious, Hdt., Thuc., etc.; of a person, ἐπικίνδυνος ἦν μὴ λαμφθείη was in danger of being taken, Hdt.:— adv. -νως, in a precarious or critical state, Soph.: at one's risk, Thuc.
to lend, τί τινι Plut.
tearful, Ar.
to bend to or besides:—Pass. to be bent double, Luc.
metaph. to bow down, τινα Plut.:—Pass., ἐπικλασθῆναι τῇ γνώμῃ to be broken in spirit, Thuc.; but also, to be bent or turned to pity, Id.
to shut to, close, as a door, Ar.:—Mid., Luc.
to extol or praise the more, Od.
an accusation, charge, Soph., Eur.
by surname, by name, Plat.
an heiress, Ar., etc.
to assign by lot, τί τινι Dem., etc.
a surname or additional name; the acc. being used absol. as adv., by surname, Ἀστυάναξ, ὃν Τρῶες ἐπίκλησιν καλέουσι Astyanax, as they call him by surname (his name being Scamandrius), Il., etc.
generally, a name, Thuc.
an imputation, Id.
a calling upon, invocation, appeal, Plut., Luc.
called upon, called in as allies, Hdt., Thuc.
specially summoned, Hdt.; ἐπίκλητοι privy-councillors, among the Persians, Id.
a supernumerary guest, Lat. umbra, Ar.
sloping, Thuc., Plut.
to put a door to: Pass., perf. part. ἐπικεκλῐμέναι σανίδες closed doors, Il.
to bend towards, τὰ ὦτα ἐπ. to prick the ears, Xen.:— Pass., κεραῖαι ἐπικεκλιμέναι spars inclined at an angle to the wall, Thuc.
intr. to incline towards, πρός τι Dem.
Pass. to lie over against a place, c. dat., Eur.
in Pass., also, to lie down at table, Anth.
thievish, wily, Od., Aesch.
c. gen., ἐπίκλοπος μύθων cunning in speech, Hom.
to overflow, Il., Thuc.
metaph. to deluge, swamp, Eur.; ἐπ. τινὰ κακοῖς Luc.
metaph., also, to sweep away, liquidate the expenses, Aeschin.
an overflow, flood, Thuc.

entry.etym: = ἐπακούω, c. acc., Il.; c. gen., Od.

entry.sense: to spin to one, of the Fates who spun the thread of destiny: then, generally, to assign as one's lot or destiny, Od., Aesch.:—so in Mid., Hom.:—Pass., aor1 part., τὰ ἐπικλωσθέντα one's destinies, Plat.

entry.etym: epic 3rd sg. imperf. ἐπικνῆ for ἐπέκναε
entry.sense: to scrape or grate over, Il., Ar.
to cut on the surface, Anth.
Pass. to fall asleep over a thing, c. dat., Plat., Luc.
Mid. to consult with, τινι περί τινος Plat.
common to many, promiscuous, Hdt.: — sharing equally in a thing, c. gen., Eur.:—neut. pl. ἐπίκοινα as adv. in common, Hdt.
to communicate with a person, c. dat., Plat., etc.
to have a share of a thing in common with another, τινός τινι Id.
to add boastingly, Eur., Plut.
= ἐπι-κομπάζω, Thuc.
to boast of, τι Id.
fit for cutting: as Subst., ἐπίκοπον, ου, τό, a chopping-block, Luc.
to strike upon (i. e. from above), to fell, Od.
metaph. to cut short, reprove, Plut.
in Mid. to smite one's breast, mourn for another, c. acc., Eur.
Mid. to arm oneself against, τινι Luc.
to add ornaments to, to decorate after or besides, Hdt.; θεὰν ἐπ. to honour, celebrate, Ar., Xen.
wrathful, vengeful, Aesch.; ἐπίκοτος τροφᾶς in wrath at the sons he had bred, Id.—adv. -τως, wrathfully, Id.
Epicurean, Anth.; οἱ Ἐπ. the Epicureans, Luc.
to act as an ally, Il., Hdt., etc.; τινι to one, Thuc., etc.

generally, to aid or help at need, τινί Eur., Ar.: c. dat. rei, νόσοις ἐπικουρεῖν to aid one against them, Xen.; ἐσθὴς ἐπικουρεῖ τινι does him good service, Id.; ἐπ. τροφῆι to make provision for it, Aeschin.
c. acc. rei, ἐπικουρεῖν τινι χειμῶνα to keep it off from one, Lat. defendere, Xen.
protection, χιόνος against snow, Xen.
protection, κακῶν against evils, Eur.
aid, succour, Hdt., Aesch., etc.
an auxiliary or mercenary force, Hdt., Thuc.
serving for help, assistant, Plat.
of troops, auxiliary, allied, Thuc.: τὸ ἐπικουρικόν, = ἐπικουρία II, Id.
an assister, ally, Il., Hdt.; of the allies of Troy, Τρῶες ἠδ’ ἐπίκουροι Il.
in attic, ἐπίκουροι were mercenary troops, opp. to the citizen-soldiers (πολῖται), Thuc., Xen.
= δορυφόροι, the bodyguards of kings, Hdt.
as adj. assisting, aiding, c. dat. pers., Il., Ar., etc.
c. gen. rei, defending or protecting against, Soph., Eur., Xen.
to lighten a ship by throwing out part of its cargo, Hdt.: metaph., ἐπ. τοὺς πόνους to lighten one's labours, Xen.:—c. gen. rei, to relieve of a burden, Eur.
to lift up, support, Soph.: metaph. to lift up, encourage, Xen.
to shout to or at, τινί Luc.
to bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil, Il.; νῦν μοι τόδ’ ἐπικρήηνον ἐέλδωρ grant me now this prayer, fulfil it, Id.:—Pass., χρυσῷ δ’ ἐπὶ χείλεα κεκράαντο were finished off with gold, Od.
that which is put on the head, a head-dress, cap, Eur.
the capital of a column, Id.
mastery, dominion, possession, Xen.
of a country, a realm, dominion, Id.
to rule over, c. dat., Hom.: absol. to have or hold power, Od.
to prevail in battle, be victorious, conquer, Il., Hdt.
c. gen. to prevail over, get the mastery of an enemy, Id., attic:—also to become master of, Lat. potiri, τῆς θαλάσσης, τῶν Ἑλλήνων Hdt., etc.
generally, to be superior, τῷ ναυτικῷ Thuc.; κατὰ θάλασσαν Xen.
victory over, τινος Thuc.

entry.note: and -ύω fut. -κρεμάσω attic -κρεμῶ aor1 -εκέρᾰσα epic inf. -κρῆσαι pass ἐπικρέμαμαι aor1 -εκρεμάσθην
entry.sense: to hang over, τί τινι Theogn.
Pass., to overhang, of a rock, Hhymn., Plut.: —metaph. to hang over, Lat. imminere, Thuc.
to decide, determine, Plat., etc.
master of a thing: only in comp., ἐπικρατέστερος superior, Thuc.:—adv., ἐπικρατέως, with overwhelming might, impetuously, Il., Hes.
the yard-arm of a ship, Od.
to rattle over the ground, Hes.
trodden hard, of ground, Xen.
to strike upon, ἐπ. χθόνα βάκτροις to strike the earth with staffs, Aesch.
to throw a cloak over, conceal, Aesch., Plat.:—Mid. to disguise, Id., Dem.:— to disguise oneself, conceal one's purpose, Thuc., Plut.; ἐπικρυπτόμενος with concealment or secrecy, Xen.
unknown, inglorious, Plut.
concealment, Plut.
to caw or croak at, Ar.
Dep. to gain or win besides, Hdt., Aesch., etc.
to kill besides or again, Soph.
further acquisition, fresh gain, Soph.
gained besides or in addition, newly acquired, Hdt., attic; ἐπ. γῆ, of the Delta of Egypt, Hdt.
to make a noise after, re-echo, Ar.
glorious, brilliant, successful, Xen.
Pass. to become doubly pregnant, Hdt.
intr. to come round in turn upon, Soph.
to flow in waves over, Plut.
to bend oneself or stoop over, ἐπ. ἐπί τι to stoop down to ge something, Xen.:— to lean upon, τινί Luc.
to confirm, sanction, ratify, Thuc., Xen., etc.; c. inf., Eur.
to bend forward, Hes.

entry.note: epic imperf. ἐπίκῡρον epic aor1 ἐπίκυρσα or ἐπικύρησα
entry.sense: to light upon, fall in with, c. dat., Il., Hes.
c. gen. to have a share, of, Aesch.
a guard of beehives, Anth.
to lament over a person orthing, c. acc., Soph.
to hinder, check, Soph., Thuc.
to rush in like revellers, to make a riotous assault. Ar.; εἰς τὰς πόλεις Plat.:—Pass. to be grossly maltreated, Plut.
to satirize in comedy, Plat.
up to the hilt, through and through, Ar.
to obtain the lot, to succeed another, Aeschin.
perf. ἐπι-λέλογχα, to fall to one's lot next, Soph.
Dep. to hold tight, close, Eur.
to lay hold of, seize, attack, as a disease, Hdt., Thuc.:—Pass., τὴν αἴσθησιν ἐπιληφθείς Lat. sensibus captus, Plut.
of events, to overtake, surprise, interrupt, Thuc.
to attain to, reach, Xen.; ἔτη ὀκτὼ ἐπ. to live over eight years, Thuc.
to seize, stop, esp. by pressure, Ar., etc.; ἐπ. τινὰ τῆς ὀπίσω ὁδοῦ to stop him from getting back, Hdt.
metaph., πολὺν χῶρον ἐπ. to get over much ground, traverse it rapidly, as in Virgil corripere campum, Theocr.
Mid., with perf. pass., to hold oneself on by, lay hold of, catch, c. gen., Hdt., Thuc.
to attack, τινος Xen.
to make a seizure of, τινος Dem.
to lay hold of, get, obtain, προστάτεω a chief, προφάσιος a pretext, Hdt.
of place, to gain, reach, τῶν ὀρῶν Plut.
to attempt a thing, c. gen., Id.
to take up, interrupt in speaking (cf. ὑπολαμβάνω), Plat.: to object to, Xen.
to make splendid, adorn, Plut.
to shine after or thereupon, Il., etc.; ἐπιλαμψάσης ἡμέρης when day had fully come, Hdt.
to shine upon, c. dat., Plut., Anth.
to forget, v. sub ἐπιλήθω.
to smoothe over, ἐπιλεήνας τὴν Ξέρξεω γνώμην, i. e. making it plausible, Hdt.
to choose, pick out, select, Hdt.:— Mid., τῶν Βαβυλωνίων ἐπελέξατο he chose him certain of the Babylonians, Id.; so in attic:—Pass., ἐπιλελεγμένοι or ἐπειλεγμένοι chosen men, Xen.
to say in addition, add further, Hdt.
to call by name, Id.
in ionic Gr. also, in Mid.
to think upon, think over, τι Hdt.; οὐκ ἐπ., nihil curare, Id.; c. inf. to deem or expect that, Id.; so also in Aesch.
to con over, read, Hdt.
to pour wine over a thing, Il.; to pour a libation, Od.
to leave behind, Od., Xen.
to leave untouched, Plat.
of things, to fail one, Lat. deficere, c. acc. pers., ὕδωρ μιν ἐπέλιπε the water failed him, Hdt.; ἐπιλείψει με λέγοντα ἡ ἡμέρα Dem.
in Hdt., often of rivers, ἐπ. τὸ ῥέεθρον to leave their stream empty, run dry, Hdt.; and so without ῥέεθρον, to fail, run dry, Id.
generally, to fail, be wanting, Id., Xen., etc.
a deficiency, lack, Thuc.
chosen, picked, of soldiers, Xen.
to strip of bark, Hhymn.
to look towards or at, τόσσον τίς τ’ ἐπιλεύσσει one can only see so far before one, Il.
causing to forget, τινος Od.
